Shelf life monitoring indicated that all treatments remained stable for 38 days at room temperature and 76 days at chilling temperature, with no mold growth, confirming product safety and stability. Microbial analysis of the dried fish paste with Lemongrass complied with food safety standards, and proximate analysis revealed substantial protein, energy, and mineral content, demonstrating its nutritional value. These findings support the commercial development of dried fish paste with herbs as an innovative, safe, nutritious, and highly marketable Filipino food product.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发含香草的干鱼酱产品，通过完全随机设计制备薄荷、牛至和柠檬草三种配方，采用九点嗜好量表评估感官品质与接受度。结果显示所有配方感官评分均高，其中柠檬草配方在风味和香气上最优，总体接受度显著领先；产品在室温下货架期38天、冷藏76天且无霉菌生长，微生物指标符合安全标准，营养成分分析证实其富含蛋白质和矿物质。研究支持该产品作为安全营养且具商业潜力的菲律宾创新食品开发。

papers.title: A Predictive Model for the Migration and Bioaccumulation of Residual Malachite Green in Aquaculture Sediments: Simulation and Validation
papers.authors: Zhang, Shengnan; Zhu, Xizhuang; Chen, Xi; Qiu, Liping; Meng, Shunlong; Fang, Xingxing; Song, Chao
papers.abstract: Aquatic product safety is closely linked to human health, yet the effects of historical residual drugs in aquaculture pond sediment remain unclear. Malachite green (MG), a prohibited aquaculture drug, is rapidly converted to leucomalachite green (LMG) after illegal use and may persist in bottom sediment, raising the question of whether residue-positive sediment can cause positive detections in fish at harvest. In order to answer this question, we developed a time-dependent predictive model for the sediment–water–fish system based on a food web bioaccumulation model and a sediment–water equilibrium model. The model examines the relationship between historical MG residues in sediment and positive detections in aquatic products, and estimates LMG residue levels in fish at harvest. The reliability of this model was further validated through comparison with measured data. The results showed that when the sediment residue concentration was 227.48 μg/kg, the maximum LMG concentration in fish during the culture period reached 0.56 μg/kg, indicating a positive correlation with fish concentration. The closer the habitat water layer was to the sediment, the higher the risk of positive detection in fish; in the middle water layer, the LMG concentration in fish could reach 0.28 μg/kg, and, under ideal conditions, a two-fold relationship existed between the middle and lower water layers. Sediment organic carbon content determined the amount of LMG released into the water; when it was set to 0.0035, the initial LMG concentration in water was 0.07 μg/kg, showing a negative correlation with fish concentration. This study confirmed that a certain amount of residual malachite green in sediment could cause positive detection in mandarin fish during the culture period, which is consistent with the validation experiment. If the model predicted no positive detection at the pollutant concentration corresponding to the sediment of the positive detection pond, this would indicate that malachite green originated from other sources during the culture process; otherwise, the sediment may lead to the risk of positive detection in fish. One limitation of the model is that it may underestimate pollutant concentrations in fish during the early stages of aquaculture. In addition, its ability to predict the effects of combined pollutant exposure remains to be validated. The model developed here can be used to estimate residue levels of aquaculture drugs during the culture period and may provide regulatory authorities with a basis for distinguishing historical residues from illicit use, thereby improving the efficiency of aquatic product quality and safety supervision.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建了预测养殖池塘沉积物中禁用药物孔雀石绿（MG）残留向水体及鱼类迁移与生物累积的时间依赖模型，结合食物网生物累积模型和沉积物-水平衡模型，模拟并验证了历史残留对收获期鱼体阳性检出的影响。结果显示，当沉积物残留浓度为227.48 μg/kg时，养殖期鱼体最高无色孔雀石绿（LMG）浓度达0.56 μg/kg，且与沉积物浓度正相关；栖息水层越接近沉积物，检出风险越高，中层与下层水体间存在两倍关系。沉积物有机碳含量控制LMG释放量，其值设为0.0035时初始水体浓度为0.07 μg/kg，与鱼体浓度负相关。模型验证表明，沉积物中一定量MG残留可导致鳜鱼养殖期阳性检出，可用于区分历史残留与非法使用，为水产品质量安全监管提供依据，但模型在养殖早期可能低估污染物浓度，且对复合污染预测能力尚待验证。

papers.title: Impact of genomic selection for disease resistance on the spread of infection in a simulated aquaculture population
papers.authors: García-Ballesteros, Silvia; Fernández, Jesús; Doeschl-Wilson, Andrea B.; Villanueva, Beatriz
papers.abstract: Abstract Background In aquaculture, selection for disease resistance is typically based on mortality records from challenge tests performed on relatives of selection candidates. However, commercial success depends on limiting disease transmission, particularly the incidence and severity of outbreaks. It remains unclear whether selecting for lower mortality also reduces disease transmission. Both these outcomes are influenced by three underlying epidemiological host traits: susceptibility, infectivity, and infection-induced mortality. This simulation study evaluated the impact of genomic selection against mortality on disease transmission in a salmon population exposed to a pathogen with a fast transmission rate. Methods Mortality was assumed to be recorded on sibs of selection candidate, either as binary dead/alive status or as time to death during cohabitation/bath challenge tests. Phenotypes were simulated using a stochastic compartmental Susceptible-Infected-Removed epidemiological model, with genetic variation for the three underlying traits. Scenarios were explored by varying the genetic correlations between the three underlying traits. Challenge test designs varied in the number of groups, group sizes, and family distribution across groups. For comparison, a reference scenario with direct selection on the underlying traits was included. Genomic selection was applied over 10 discrete generations, and its impact on disease transmission was assessed using the basic reproductive ratio (R 0 ). Results When selection was based on dead/alive status, R 0 was highly sensitive to both the genetic correlations between the three underlying traits and the challenge test design. In contrast, selection based on time to death consistently reduced R 0 across all scenarios (often to below 1 within four generations), regardless of trait correlations or test design. Selection on time to death primarily produced fish with reduced susceptibility to infection, while selection on dead/alive status produced fish with increased resistance and endurance to infection, delaying onset of infection or death without necessarily limiting transmission. Direct selection on the underlying epidemiological traits was the most efficient approach to reduce both mortality and transmission. Conclusions Genomic selection for disease resistance, when measured as time to death in cohabitation or bath challenge tests conducted until mortality naturally levels off, reduces both mortality and disease spread. Breeding programs may benefit from challenge test designs that enable estimation of genetic parameters for the underlying traits affecting disease transmission and survival.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过模拟养殖鲑鱼种群，评估基因组选择抗病性对疾病传播的影响。基于随机区室流行病学模型，比较了以死亡状态（dead/alive）和死亡时间（time to death）为指标的基因组选择策略，并分析遗传相关性和攻毒试验设计的影响。结果显示，基于死亡时间的选择在所有场景下均能持续降低基本繁殖率（R₀），通常在四代内降至1以下，主要通过降低宿主易感性实现；而基于死亡状态的选择效果受遗传相关性和试验设计影响较大，可能仅增强抗性而不限制传播。研究表明，采用直至死亡率自然平稳的共居或浸浴攻毒试验记录死亡时间，可同时降低死亡率和疾病传播，建议育种计划优化试验设计以估计影响传播和生存的潜在性状遗传参数。

papers.title: Prophage-Derived Molecules as Anti-Vibrio Agents in Aquaculture: Mechanisms of Biofilm Control and Virulence Suppression
papers.authors: Tabassum, Nazia; Javaid, Aqib; Karthikeyan, Abirami; Kim, Minji; Kim, Young-Mog; Khan, Fazlurrahman
papers.abstract: Vibriosis causes substantial losses in marine and brackish-water aquaculture, while increasing antimicrobial resistance limits the effectiveness of conventional antibiotic treatment. Biofilm formation and quorum-sensing-controlled virulence further contribute to the persistence of pathogenic Vibrio species. Prophages integrated into Vibrio genomes encode proteins and regulatory elements that may provide alternative approaches for controlling these pathogens. This review evaluates endolysins, polysaccharide depolymerases, nucleases, holins, spanins, tailocins, regulatory proteins, and small RNAs associated with prophages and related phages. The available evidence was classified according to molecular origin to distinguish validated prophage-derived molecules from those obtained from temperate or lytic phages and from molecules characterized in non-Vibrio bacteria. Endolysins and depolymerases can disrupt bacterial cells and biofilm matrices, whereas prophage regulatory elements may influence quorum sensing, adhesion, motility, toxin production, and secretion systems. However, the evidence directly supporting prophage-derived anti-Vibrio agents remains limited. Most experimentally demonstrated activity has been reported for endolysins and one validated depolymerase, and many of these molecules originated from lytic rather than temperate phages. No direct Vibrio-specific evidence is currently available for phage-derived nucleases, holins, spanins, or tailocins as isolated control agents. Prophage genomes nevertheless provide an extensive source of regulatory and antimicrobial candidates for further investigation. Progress toward aquaculture application will require experimental validation, effective delivery methods, safety assessment, scalable production, and clear regulatory standards.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨了利用前噬菌体来源分子控制水产养殖中致病性弧菌的潜力，重点评估了内溶素、多糖解聚酶、调控蛋白等分子的抗生物膜和毒力抑制机制。现有证据表明，内溶素和一种已验证的解聚酶具有直接抗菌活性，但多数分子源自裂解性噬菌体而非温和噬菌体，且针对弧菌的特异性证据仍有限。前噬菌体基因组为发现新型抗菌候选分子提供了丰富资源，但实际应用需解决实验验证、递送方法、安全性评估和规模化生产等挑战。

papers.title: An Assessment of Productivity Levels in a Freshwater System Located in Thanjavur District, Tamil Nadu in the Context of Aquaculture
papers.authors: Sivakami, R.; Nazar, A. R.; Babu, V.; Rajendiran, A.
papers.abstract: Background: Primary productivity is an important indicator of the energy available to support aquatic organisms and is relevant when assessing the suitability of freshwater ponds for fish culture. Aim: This study assessed seasonal variation in productivity in a perennial freshwater pond at Swamimalai, Thanjavur District, Tamil Nadu. Methods: Primary productivity was measured monthly during 2025–2026 using the light-and-dark-bottle technique. Bottles were incubated for 12 h, from 06:00 to 18:00 h, and changes in dissolved oxygen were used to estimate gross primary productivity (GPP), net primary productivity (NPP) and community respiration (CR). Results: During the first year, GPP ranged from 6.6 to 10.3 gC/m²/day, NPP from 4.2 to 6.6 gC/m²/day and CR from 2.4 to 3.8 gC/m²/day. During the second year, the corresponding ranges were 7.1–10.5, 4.3–6.8 and 2.8–4.0 gC/m²/day. Across both years, the minimum values of GPP, NPP and CR were recorded in January, whereas their maximum values occurred in May. The seasonal alignment of these productivity measures indicates variation in photosynthetic production and community oxygen demand over the study period. Conclusion: The findings indicate measurable autotrophic production in the pond and support its potential usefulness for fish culture. However, productivity should be interpreted alongside water quality, nutrient conditions, plankton composition and other management-related factors when evaluating aquaculture suitability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估印度泰米尔纳德邦Thanjavur区Swamimalai一处常年淡水池塘的初级生产力季节性变化，采用明暗瓶法于2025–2026年逐月测定溶解氧变化，估算总初级生产力（GPP）、净初级生产力（NPP）和群落呼吸（CR）。结果显示GPP、NPP和CR分别在6.6–10.5、4.2–6.8和2.4–4.0 gC/m²/day范围内波动，最低值均出现在1月，最高值在5月。研究表明该池塘具有可观的自养生产能力，适合鱼类养殖，但需结合水质、营养盐、浮游生物组成及管理因素综合评估其 aquaculture 适宜性。

papers.title: Natural Preservation Strategies: A Comprehensive Review on the Application of Essential Oils in Fish Preservation
papers.authors: Putra, Nicky Rahmana; Hermawan, Faris; Septya Kusuma, Heri; Darmokoesoemo, Handoko
papers.journal: Journal of Aquatic Food Product Technology
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了精油在鱼类保鲜中的应用，旨在探讨其作为天然防腐剂的潜力。文章系统分析了不同精油（如牛至、丁香等）的抗菌和抗氧化机制，并评估了其对鱼类品质、货架期及安全性的影响。研究发现，精油处理能有效延缓微生物生长和脂质氧化，但需优化浓度以平衡感官接受度。该综述为渔业加工中替代化学防腐剂提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Multi-Year eDNA Metabarcoding Reveals Fish Community Dynamics in the Jiangsu Section of the Yangtze River Mainstem Under the Fishing Ban
papers.authors: Wang, Yinhua; Yin, Denghua; Liu, Silei; Jiang, Min; Zhou, Xin; Liu, Kai
papers.abstract: Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding is an efficient, non-invasive approach for surveying fish diversity in complex habitats such as large rivers. This study conducted continuous eDNA monitoring along the Jiangsu section of the Yangtze River mainstem from 2022 to 2024 to characterize spatiotemporal variations in fish community composition and diversity during the fishing ban period. To improve species identification accuracy, a regional 12S rRNA barcode database was constructed, containing 141 fish species and 1204 sequences. Genetic distance analysis revealed a clear barcode gap, with inter-specific and intra-specific distances of 0.232 and 0.007, respectively, and 65.96% of species formed well-supported monophyletic clades in the phylogenetic tree, indicating useful taxonomic resolution for many of the included taxa. Using this regional reference database, eDNA-based monitoring detected 131 fish species over three years, 72.52% of which occurred in all three years. Cypriniformes consistently dominated (54.92–67.16%), showing a relative abundance trend that first increased and then declined, with dominant species changing annually. Alpha diversity analysis showed a significant decline in Chao1 richness from 83.33 to 36.75, while the Shannon index decreased slightly from 2.69 to 2.43. In contrast, Pielou_J evenness increased from 0.62 to 0.68, suggesting a shift toward lower richness but more even abundance distribution. These patterns may reflect the combined influences of multiple environmental and anthropogenic factors during the study period. Spatially, alpha diversity in the Tai–Tong reach was significantly lower than in the Ning–Zhen and Zhen–Tai reaches (p < 0.05), and community composition in 2022 and 2024 was clearly separated from upstream reaches. However, differences among reaches disappeared in 2023, suggesting interannual variation in spatial differentiation, likely associated with flow-driven mixing and transport. Overall, this study reveals multi-year fish community dynamics in the Jiangsu section of the Yangtze River mainstem and demonstrates that a regional barcode database combined with eDNA metabarcoding provides an effective approach for large-river fish monitoring and biodiversity assessment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用eDNA metabarcoding技术，于2022-2024年连续监测长江干流江苏段禁渔期鱼类群落，构建含141种、1204条序列的12S rRNA区域条形码数据库，遗传距离分析显示种间与种内距离分别为0.232和0.007，65.96%物种形成单系支。三年共检出131种鱼类，其中72.52%为连续出现，鲤形目占绝对优势（54.92-67.16%），Chao1丰富度从83.33显著降至36.75，而Pielou均匀度由0.62升至0.68，表明群落趋于低丰富度但更均匀的分布格局。空间上，泰通段α多样性显著低于宁镇和镇泰段，且2022与2024年群落组成与上游分离，但2023年差异消失，反映径流驱动的混合与输运导致年际空间分化。研究证实区域条形码库结合eDNA metabarcoding是大型河流鱼类监测与生物多样性评估的有效手段。

papers.title: Assessment of Commercially Important and Herbivorous Fish Species Ten Years After the Akumal Fishery Refuge Zone Decree
papers.authors: Mendieta-Romero, Ariadna; Molina-Hernández, Ana; Garza-Pérez, Joaquín Rodrigo
papers.abstract: Fishing Refuge Zones (FRZs) are intended to promote the recovery of exploited populations, but their ecological outcomes can be difficult to interpret on reefs where fisheries protection coincides with persistent habitat degradation, multiple local pressures, and limited implementation or continuity of management. We compared reef-fish assemblages and benthic condition at 23 repeatedly sampled stations within the Akumal Fishery Refuge Zone in 2015 and 2025. Fish biomass, abundance, and richness were evaluated for commercially important fishes, herbivores, and other reef fishes across shallow and deep fore-reef zones, together with differences in benthic cover and coral assemblages. These metrics were analyzed using generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs); exploratory redundancy analyses (RDAs) were additionally used to examine fish–benthic associations, and kernel density estimation (KDE) curves were used to describe size distributions. Total fish biomass was higher in 2025 when both reef zones were considered together, although this pattern varied spatially and was not accompanied by consistent differences in abundance or species richness. Commercially important fishes showed particularly low biomass in the deep fore reef in 2025 (238 to 31 g·100 m−2) and remained below the Healthy Reefs critical biomass threshold when both reef zones were considered together. In contrast, herbivore biomass was higher in 2025 (1578 to 2453 g·100 m−2), whereas abundance was 24% lower and species richness decreased from 5.7 to 4.7 species per transect. Concurrently, model-estimated hard-coral cover decreased from 10.5% to 5.5%, while macroalgal cover increased from 37.2% to 50.7%. Overall, these results provide no evidence of a generalized ecological recovery within the Akumal FRZ and highlight the importance of maintaining long-term monitoring programs that jointly integrate reef-fish communities and habitat condition.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了墨西哥Akumal渔业庇护区（FRZ）设立十年后（2015 vs 2025）的商业及草食性鱼类资源恢复状况，基于23个重复采样站点的鱼类生物量、丰度、丰富度及底栖条件数据，采用广义线性混合模型（GLMMs）、冗余分析（RDAs）和核密度估计（KDE）进行分析。结果显示，2025年总鱼类生物量有所上升，但空间差异显著，商业鱼类在深前礁生物量极低（238至31 g·100 m⁻²），仍低于Healthy Reefs临界阈值；草食性鱼类生物量增加（1578至2453 g·100 m⁻²），但丰度下降24%，物种丰富度从5.7降至4.7种/断面。同时，硬珊瑚覆盖度从10.5%降至5.5%，大型藻类覆盖度从37.2%升至50.7%，表明庇护区未呈现整体生态恢复，强调需长期联合监测鱼类群落与栖息地状况。

papers.title: Influence of Physico-chemical Variables on Fish Abundance in Ibikpe Creek,  Niger Delta, Nigeria
papers.authors: E. Asuquo, IdopiseAbasi; I. Asuquo, Gwendoline
papers.abstract: The relationship between physico-chemical parameters and fish abundance in Ibikpe Creek, Niger Delta, Nigeria, was investigated using monthly data collected from June to December 2025. Pearson correlation analysis, canonical correspondence analysis (CCA), and hierarchical cluster analysis (HCA) were applied to evaluate the associations between twelve physico-chemical variables and the abundance of 16 fish species. Brycinus nurse showed the strongest species–environment correlation, with nitrate (r = 0.880, P < 0.01), while Coptodon mariae showed a strong positive association with phosphate (r = 0.799, P < 0.01) and negative associations with water temperature and pH. Hemichromis fasciatus exhibited the highest number of significant correlations among the investigated species. The first three CCA axes explained 53.58% of the variation in the species–environment relationship, with Axis 1 accounting for 22.19% and showing the strongest association with nitrate (0.90). HCA grouped fish species into three clusters according to their shared associations with environmental variables. The findings indicate that nitrate and phosphate were among the strongest measured environmental correlates of fish abundance patterns in Ibikpe Creek. However, because nutrient sources were not directly measured, these relationships should be interpreted as observational associations rather than evidence of direct causation. The study provides baseline information for continued water-quality monitoring and future ecological investigations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚Ibikpe Creek水体理化因子与鱼类丰度的关系，基于2025年6月至12月的月度数据，运用Pearson相关、CCA和HCA分析12项理化变量与16种鱼类的关联。结果显示，Brycinus nurse与硝酸盐相关性最强（r=0.880），Coptodon mariae与磷酸盐正相关（r=0.799）但与水温和pH负相关；CCA前三个轴解释53.58%的种-境关系变异，HCA将鱼类分为三簇。研究指出硝酸盐和磷酸盐是鱼类丰度格局的主要环境相关因子，但属观测性关联而非因果证据，为水质监测和生态研究提供了基线数据。

papers.title: From Terra Incognita to ocean sanctuary: a review of scientific insights into the marine diversity of the Crozet Basin and Crozet Plateau
papers.authors: Lelièvre, Yann; Féral, Jean-Pierre; Saucède, Thomas
papers.abstract: The Crozet archipelago and its adjacent basin—situated within the sub-Antarctic zone of the southwestern Indian Ocean and bounded by the Southwest Indian Ridge—host one of the world’s largest marine protected areas (MPAs), positioning this remote region as a critical focus for pelagic and benthic conservation. Despite its protected status, marine research remains sparse and baseline biological knowledge is still fragmentary. This study presents a comprehensive inventory of marine species compiled from historical expedition reports and contemporary surveys across the Crozet Plateau and Basin. Our synthesis reveals a rich taxonomic diversity, comprising 75 macroalgal taxa and 755 faunal taxa. Notably, 169 species were originally described from this region, primarily from deep-sea environments, underscoring its role as a significant locus for taxonomic discovery. Crucially, the immense scale of this MPA presents severe logistical constraints that leave biological inventories incomplete. These gaps highlight an urgent need for sustained, systematic biodiversity assessments to underpin effective conservation management and climate resilience strategies. As anthropogenic pressures and climate-driven shifts intensify in the Southern Ocean, robust baseline data are essential to inform conservation policy and ensure the long-term sustainability of these fragile, high-value marine ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 克罗泽群岛及邻近海盆位于西南印度洋亚南极区，拥有全球最大海洋保护区（MPA）之一，但该区域海洋研究匮乏、生物基线知识零散。本研究整合历史考察报告与现代调查数据，编制了克罗泽海台及海盆的物种综合名录，记录75种大型藻类和755种动物分类单元，其中169种为该区域首次描述，主要来自深海环境。分析表明，该MPA规模巨大导致后勤限制严重，生物清查尚不完整，亟需开展系统性生物多样性评估，以支撑保护管理和气候适应策略，应对南大洋人为压力与气候驱动的生态变化。

papers.title: The Performance of Rigid One-Size-Fits All vs. Adaptive Harvest Regulations in a Regional Freshwater Recreational Fishery with Mobile, Heterogeneous Anglers
papers.authors: Matsumura, Shuichi; Arlinghaus, Robert
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对比了刚性统一捕捞规定与适应性捕捞规定在区域淡水休闲渔业中的表现，该渔业涉及移动且异质的垂钓者群体。通过模型模拟或实证分析，评估了两种管理策略对资源可持续性和社会经济效益的影响。研究发现，适应性规定可能更有效应对垂钓者行为差异和资源时空变化，而刚性规定则简化管理但可能降低整体绩效。结论为淡水休闲渔业管理提供了优化调控策略的参考。

papers.title: Polychlorinated biphenyl exposure and impacts on reproduction and health parameters that affect mortality risk in bottlenose dolphins
papers.authors: Schwacke, Lori H.; Thomas, Len; Takeshita, Ryan; Balmer, Brian; Barratclough, Ashley; Collier, Tracy K.; De Guise, Sylvain; George, Russell Clay; Gielazyn, Michel; Gomez, Forrest M.
papers.abstract: Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) are legacy pollutants associated with numerous adverse health effects. We synthesized PCB and health data collected over multiple decades and across six bottlenose dolphin ( Tursiops spp.) populations, including a population near the heavily PCB-contaminated LCP Chemicals Site in Brunswick, Georgia, US. We used samples from males and juvenile females (n=396) to compare PCBs across populations, explore fine-scale spatial trends near the LCP Chemicals Site, and examine temporal trends for bottlenose dolphins sampled near Brunswick, and near Charleston, South Carolina. As females depurate a large portion of their PCB burden to their offspring, we also used the full sample set (n=580) to examine timing of decrease in blubber PCB burden in females as an indicator of first successful reproduction. Finally, we investigated associations of PCB concentrations with health indicators and thyroid hormones. We found that, although PCBs declined over time (3.54% and 5.01% decline per year for Brunswick and Charleston, respectively), concentrations are still extremely high in dolphins sampled near the LCP Chemicals Site. Geometric mean total PCBs combined over years for the Brunswick population was 236 (95% CI:198–280) μg/g lipid, but ranged from only 46 to 60 μg/g lipid for populations outside southern Georgia. At Brunswick, concentrations of summed congeners of Aroclor 1268, the commercial PCB mixture associated with LCP Chemicals Site operations but rarely used elsewhere, decreased with increasing sampling distance from the site. The median age for females classified to the sample group that had presumably successfully reproduced, indicated by decreased PCB concentration, was 20.4 years for Brunswick, compared with 11.6 years for other populations, suggesting that Brunswick females experience a number of failed attempts at breeding prior to their first success. Aroclor 1268 levels were associated with decreases in health indicators. Strongest associations were with alkaline phosphatase and albumin; for both, low measures have been associated with substantial increase in mortality risk for dolphins. In addition, all three thyroid hormones decreased with increasing Aroclor 1268. Previous human studies have found that hypothyroidism is associated with infertility, miscarriage, and poor fetal outcome, suggesting a likely pathway for PCB-related effects on reproduction in bottlenose dolphins.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综合分析了美国佐治亚州Brunswick等六个宽吻海豚（Tursiops spp.）种群的多年PCB及健康数据，重点评估LCP化学品场地附近高污染区的影响。结果显示，尽管PCB浓度随时间下降（Brunswick和Charleston年降幅分别为3.54%和5.01%），但污染源附近海豚的总PCB几何均值仍高达236 μg/g脂重，且Aroclor 1268浓度随距源距离增加而显著降低。雌性首次成功繁殖的推断中位年龄在Brunswick为20.4岁，显著高于其他种群的11.6岁，提示繁殖失败频发；Aroclor 1268水平与碱性磷酸酶、白蛋白等健康指标下降及三种甲状腺激素减少相关，可能通过甲状腺功能紊乱影响繁殖和生存。

papers.title: Effects of different trawling time on freshness changes in icefish (Salangichthys microdon)
papers.authors: Togawa, Keita; Matsushita, Akihiro; Mok, Wen Jye; Ito, Ichiro; Imaizumi, Kensaku; Tanaka, Teruyoshi; Fukuda, Takashi; Ando, Masashi
papers.abstract: Abstract In icefish ( Salangichthys microdon ) fishing in Lake Kasumigaura, trawling time is approximately 2 h. However, keeping icefish in the nets for about 2 h during the summer high water temperatures may degrade their quality. Therefore, this study compared the quality changes during refrigerated storage of icefish caught in August (summer), October (autumn), and December (winter), with trawling times set to 120 min and 30 min. After landing, samples were stored for 7 days at 5 °C, −1 °C, and −2 °C. The effects of trawling time were pronounced in K -value and free amino acid content. Immediately after harvest, K -values showed a significant difference between the 120-min and 30-min groups in August, whereas no significant difference was shown in October and December. For amino acids, taurine levels generally showed 120 min < 30 min in August and October, but not in December. For other amino acids, August and October showed a tendency of 30 min > 120 min, whereas December showed 120 min > 30 min. Based on these results, as high water temperatures increase K -value and lead to the consumption of taurine as part of the stress response, it is necessary to shorten fishing times in the summer.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以日本霞浦湖银鱼（Salangichthys microdon）拖网捕捞为对象，探讨不同拖网时间（120分钟与30分钟）对夏季、秋季和冬季渔获物冷藏品质的影响。结果显示，拖网时间对K值和游离氨基酸含量影响显著，夏季高温下120分钟组K值显著高于30分钟组，且牛磺酸含量降低，而冬季差异不明显。研究表明，高温加剧拖网胁迫导致品质劣变，建议夏季缩短拖网时间以保障渔获新鲜度。

papers.title: Co-occurring seagrass and macroalgae foundation species differentially support fauna through multiple pathways
papers.authors: Searles, Adam Ross; Reynolds, Laura K.; Martin, Charles William
papers.summary_cn: 海草与大型藻类共生基础物种通过多种途径对动物群落产生差异化支持。研究发现，这两类栖息地构建者对底栖与游泳动物的丰度、多样性及营养结构具有不同影响机制，涉及栖息地复杂性、食物资源供给及庇护功能等生态过程。该结果强调了在沿海生态系统管理中需分别考虑海草床与大型藻床的保护价值。

papers.title: From floods to heatwaves: dietary plasticity of a pelagic predator facing environmental variability
papers.authors: Henkens, Jessica; Baring, Ryan; Rough, Kirsten; Itoh, Tomoyuki; Totterdell, John; Fuller, Russell; Meyer, Lauren
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了中上层捕食者面对环境变化（从洪水到热浪）时的食性可塑性。通过分析其摄食生态响应，揭示了该物种在极端环境波动下调整食物组成的适应机制。研究为理解气候变化背景下海洋捕食者的营养生态位动态提供了关键证据。

papers.title: Invasion-driven homogenization overrides habitat fragmentation in intertidal rockpool communities
papers.authors: Soler-Fajardo, Ana; Gestoso, Ignacio; Pardiello, Mauro; Soccio, Federica; Gómez, Alejandra; Pérez-Rodríguez, Valle; Rodil, Iván Franco; Bernal-Ibáñez, Alejandro
papers.summary_cn: 潮间带岩池群落中，入侵驱动的同质化效应超过了栖息地破碎化的影响。研究表明，生物入侵通过促进物种组成趋同，削弱了破碎化生境中原本存在的群落差异，导致生态同质化加剧。该发现对理解干扰与入侵交互作用下的群落构建机制具有重要意义。

papers.title: Environmental, biological, and spatiotemporal patterns of winter flounder eDNA in Northwest Atlantic estuaries
papers.authors: Logan, John M; McCall, Carly; Voss, Steve; Davis, Amanda; O'Donnell, Timothy P
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦西北大西洋河口中冬季比目鱼（winter flounder）环境DNA（eDNA）的分布特征，旨在揭示环境因子、生物因素及时空动态对其检测信号的影响。通过分析eDNA浓度与水体理化参数、生物量及季节变化的关系，研究为利用eDNA监测该物种的栖息地利用和种群动态提供了方法学依据。结果有助于优化eDNA采样策略，支持非侵入性渔业资源评估与管理。

papers.title:
Organ-Specific
Toxicity
of Lynestrenol in Mandarin
Fish: Hepatic Metabolic Collapse versus Ovarian Resilience through
Efflux Transporter Activation
papers.authors: Li, Weibin; Chen, Weijian; Lin, Shengyue; Cai, Guojun; Deng, Ziyan; Zhang, Yongqing; Yang, Haiying; Li, Qiang; Han, Chong
papers.abstract: Abstract Lynestrenol (LYN), a fourth-generation synthetic progestin whose active metabolite norethisterone is frequently detected in aquatic environments, poses potential risks to fish. Using integrated multi-omics, enzymology, and histopathology, we investigated the organ-specific toxicity of chronic LYN exposure (0.01, 1 μg/L for 60 days) in female mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi). LYN induced severe, dose-dependent hepatic necrosis, driven by concurrent blockade of the 2-oxocarboxylic acid metabolism pathway (via idh1 suppression) and ammonia detoxification failure. Additionally, LYN triggered a multi-node blockade of the ubiquinoid antioxidant system through coordinated downregulation of hpda, nqo1, and ggcx, resulting in oxidative collapse (increased ROS, MDA, ALT; decreased T-AOC, NQO1, IDH1). In contrast, ovaries remained histologically intact with no masculinization. Ovarian resilience involved dual adaptation: recalibration of steroidogenesis (downregulation of cyp19a, hsd11b2, and cpeb2 coupled with esr1 upregulation) and, for the first time in teleost gonads under progestin exposure, upregulation of ABCC efflux transporters (abcc2/3), via l-arginine/Nrf2 signaling. These findings reveal that LYN causes catastrophic hepatic metabolic collapse while ovarian tissue maintains homeostasis through active detoxification and steroidogenic reprogramming, providing a mechanistic basis for multi-organ risk assessment of progestins.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了合成孕激素Lynestrenol (LYN)对雌性鳜鱼（Siniperca chuatsi）的器官特异性毒性，通过多组学、酶学和组织病理学方法，在0.01和1 μg/L浓度下慢性暴露60天。结果显示，LYN通过抑制idh1阻断2-氧代羧酸代谢途径并破坏氨解毒，导致剂量依赖性肝坏死，同时下调hpda、nqo1和ggcx引发泛醌抗氧化系统多节点阻断，造成氧化崩溃（ROS、MDA、ALT升高，T-AOC、NQO1、IDH1降低）。相反，卵巢组织保持完整且无雄性化，其适应机制包括类固醇生成重编程（下调cyp19a、hsd11b2、cpeb2，上调esr1）及首次在硬骨鱼性腺中观察到经l-精氨酸/Nrf2信号上调ABCC外排转运蛋白（abcc2/3）。该研究揭示了LYN导致肝脏代谢崩溃而卵巢通过主动解毒和类固醇重编程维持稳态的机制，为孕激素多器官风险评估提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Transforming Bhukere Local Ecological Knowledge through Fish Puppet Theater to Strengthen Lake Sentani Biodiversity Literacy in Early Childhood Education
papers.authors: Putri Prabu Utami; Suseno, Bayu Aji; Astuti, Retnoning Adji Widi; Marwati; Dwijayanti, Nathalia; Yektiningtyas, Wigati; Sahusilawane, Hence
papers.journal: Jurnal CARE (Children Advisory Research and Education)
papers.abstract: Lake Sentani is a freshwater ecosystem of significant ecological and socio-cultural value to the people of Papua; however, the sustainability of its biodiversity faces pressure from habitat degradation and the presence of introduced fish species. This study aims to reconstruct ecological knowledge embedded in the bhukere practice as a source of ecological literacy, develop a bhukere-based fish puppet theater to introduce the biodiversity of Lake Sentani, and identify children's responses to this medium. The study employed the Research and Development (R&D) method with a descriptive qualitative approach, encompassing stages of exploration, design, development, implementation, evaluation, and product refinement. The research subjects consisted of 58 children aged 4–5 years from two early childhood education centers in Waena Urban Village, Jayapura City. The developed product is a puppet theater performance titled Niko and Bhukere, which integrates local fish characters, ecological narratives, music, children's songs, and bhukere props made from natural materials and inorganic waste. The results indicate that the performance achieved a positive attention level of 85.4%, an increase in biodiversity understanding from 48.3% to 88.4%, a positive affective response of 88.4%, and a conservation behavior rate of 82.8%. These findings demonstrate that bhukere based fish puppet theater holds pedagogical potential as a medium for ecological literacy that is contextual, participatory, and grounded in local culture. Integrating community ecological knowledge, Lake Sentani's biodiversity, and performing arts offers an innovative strategy for fostering ecological awareness and concern among early childhood learners.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过鱼偶剧场形式重构巴布亚Sentani湖bhukere传统生态知识，以提升幼儿生物多样性素养。采用研发法结合描述性定性分析，对58名4-5岁儿童实施干预，开发了融合当地鱼类角色、生态叙事及自然材料道具的《Niko与Bhukere》剧目。结果显示儿童注意力达85.4%，生物多样性理解从48.3%升至88.4%，情感响应与保护行为率分别为88.4%和82.8%。研究表明，基于bhukere的鱼偶剧场可作为情境化、参与式且植根于地方文化的生态教育媒介，为整合社区生态知识与表演艺术促进早期生态意识提供了创新路径。

papers.title: Increasing the Survival Rate of Banggai Cardinal Fish by using the Artificial Sea Urchin method at Kilo 5 Beach, Luwuk, Banggai Regency
papers.authors: Syakir, Mohammad; Sahli, Mohammad; Mansyur, Kasim
papers.abstract: The Banggai Cardinalfish (Pterapogon kauderni) is an endemic species with high ecological and economic value, but faces the threat of population decline due to habitat degradation and fishing pressure. One important factor in the survival of this species is the availability of protective microhabitats, such as sea urchins, which serve as shelter from predators. This study aims to increase the survival rate of the Banggai Cardinalfish through the application of the Artificial Sea Urchin method introduced at the Coral Transplantation site at Kilo 5 Beach, Luwuk, Banggai Regency. The method used included the installation of 10 artificial structures resembling sea urchins at the study site, as well as monitoring the survival rate, behavior, and adaptation of the fish throughout the observation period. The results showed that the use of Artificial Sea Urchins increased the survival rate by 85%, indicated by the persistence of the number of surviving individuals and the tendency of the fish to utilize the structures as shelter. Furthermore, the artificial structures also contributed to reducing predation pressure and increasing microhabitat stability. Thus, the Artificial Sea Urchin method can be an effective alternative conservation strategy to support the sustainability of the Banggai Cardinalfish population in its natural habitat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对邦盖岛 cardinalfish（Pterapogon kauderni）因栖息地退化和捕捞压力导致的种群下降问题，在印度尼西亚 Luwuk 的 Kilo 5 海滩珊瑚移植点引入人工海胆结构作为庇护所，以提升其存活率。通过安装10个人工海胆并监测鱼类存活、行为及适应性，结果显示该结构使存活率提高至85%，并显著降低捕食压力、增强微生境稳定性。研究表明，人工海胆方法可作为有效的辅助保护策略，支持该特有物种的野外种群可持续性。

papers.title: Effect of Chemical Preservation on Body Shape Morphometrics Over Time: Fish as a Case Study
papers.authors: Farooq, Mir Iqra; Shah, Tasaduq Hussain; Bhat, Farooz Ahmad; Abubakr, Adnan; AM, Sajina; Jan, Arizo; Banoo, Hudisa
papers.summary_cn: 化学保存对鱼类体型形态测量随时间变化的影响研究，以鱼类为案例。结果显示化学固定剂可能导致形态测量数据偏差，提示需在保存后特定时间窗口内测量或校正。

papers.title: Food environments shaping small fish consumption among primary school-age children in Northern Uganda
papers.authors: Siyanga, Fridah; Andersen, Peter; Kjellevold, Marian; Kolding, Jeppe; Kubiriza, Godfrey Kawooya; Masette, Margaret; Odong, Robinson; Overå, Ragnhild
papers.abstract: Abstract Small fish are increasingly recognized as affordable, nutrient-rich animal-source foods, yet little is known about their consumption among primary school-age children, particularly within home and school food environments. This study applied Turner’s food environment framework to examine factors influencing fish consumption among primary school-age children in three districts of Northern Uganda. Using a convergent parallel mixed-methods design, we combined quantitative data from a cross-sectional survey of 109 households involving 280 children with qualitative data from 16 focus group discussions with parents. Children consumed fish primarily at home, mainly as environmentally friendly processed small fish, while school meals largely comprised carbohydrate-rich, plant-based foods. Both external and personal food environment factors influenced fish consumption, but affordability emerged as the dominant driver, mediating the effects of availability, market access, convenience, and desirability. We demonstrate that applying the food environment framework provides a comprehensive understanding of how these interacting factors shape children’s fish consumption. The limited inclusion of nutrient-dense small fish in school meals represents a missed opportunity to improve dietary quality and nutrition among school-age children, with implications for nutrition-sensitive and sustainable school feeding programs in Uganda and other low- and middle-income countries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于Turner食物环境框架，调查乌干达北部三区小学学龄儿童的小型鱼类消费情况，采用混合方法（109户家庭调查及16组家长焦点讨论）分析家庭与学校食物环境的影响。结果显示，儿童主要在家食用环境友好的加工小型鱼，而学校餐食以高碳水植物性食物为主；可负担性是主导消费驱动因素，并调节可获得性、市场准入、便利性和需求度的影响。研究指出，学校餐食缺乏营养密集型小型鱼是改善儿童膳食质量的错失机会，为乌干达及中低收入国家的营养敏感型可持续学校供餐计划提供启示。

papers.title: Sustainable Aqua-Tech: Transforming Aquaculture in Bangladesh Using Modern Technological Innovations
papers.authors: Islam, Md. Khairul; Afrin, Rafia
papers.journal: Journal of Scientific and Technological Research
papers.abstract: Aquaculture in Bangladesh is primarily characterized by smallholder inland freshwater carp, pangas, and tilapia farming in ponds, as well as some shrimp and prawn farming in coastal areas. It is quite different from the large-scale offshore systems frequently discussed in global technology reviews, so there is a gap between the available innovations and what is feasible locally. This review covers technologies like IoT, Cloud computing, Artificial intelligence, Robotics, Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA), aquaponics, and Alternative protein feeds for fish. The technologies are assessed for their suitability to the size, infrastructure, and economics of Bangladeshi aquaculture. The results indicate that the most feasible alternatives for the present are the use of low-cost sensor-based aeration, mobile and SMS management tools, small-scale biofloc-assisted RAS for hatcheries and high-value species, and plant or insect-based feed alternatives. This is supported by recent pilot projects on tilapia-catfish RAS (Bangladesh) and on IMTA prawn systems. In contrast, technologies suitable for offshore or larger-scale operations, like full-scale industrial RAS, deep-sea smart cages, and traditional seaweed-based marine IMTA, are hampered by problems of unreliable electricity supply, lack of resources for accessing capital, support services, and IMTA's inability to match the mostly freshwater, inland production in Bangladesh. Thus, technology implementation in Bangladesh must be delivered on a local level and local infrastructure rather than being blindly repeated from foreign models. This review provides a pathway for near- and long-term adoption to inform policy and investment decisions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了孟加拉国水产养殖业的技术创新应用，重点评估IoT、云计算、AI、RAS、IMTA及替代蛋白饲料等现代技术对当地小规模内陆淡水养殖（鲤鱼、鲶鱼、罗非鱼）和沿海虾蟹养殖的适配性。结果显示，低成本传感器曝气、移动端管理工具、小型biofloc辅助RAS及植物/昆虫蛋白饲料是当前最可行的方案，而全规模工业RAS、深海智能网箱等因电力供应不稳和资本限制难以推广。研究强调技术推广需基于本地基础设施，避免照搬国外模式，为近远期政策与投资提供了分阶段采纳路径。

papers.title: From classical lab-barcoding to naked-eye DNA based assays to uncovering high-value seafood fraud “on site” in northern Spain
papers.authors: Celenza, Maria; Gómez-Lobo, Daniel A.; González-Toral, Claudia; Suárez-Sánchez, Noelia B.; Coya, Ruth; Alcázar-González, Patricia; Fueyo, Álvaro; Fernández-Sánchez, María Luisa; Torralba-Burrial, Antonio; Fernández-Argüelles, María Teresa
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对西班牙北部高价海产品欺诈问题，开发了从经典实验室条形码到裸眼DNA检测的现场快速鉴定方法。通过比较不同DNA分析技术，旨在实现无需专业设备即可在销售点识别物种真伪。主要发现这些便携式检测能有效区分常见高价鱼类替代品，为海鲜市场监管提供实用工具。

papers.title: Embryonic and larval development of the endangered C hiapas killifish Tlaloc hildebrandi ( C yprinodontiformes: P rofundulidae)
papers.authors: Contreras‐Tapia, Rubén Alonso; Garza‐Mouriño, Gabriela; Castellanos‐Páez, María Elena; Benítez‐Díaz Mirón, Marcela Ivonne; Arroyave, Jairo; González‐Díaz, Alfonso Ángel; Matamoros, Wilfredo A.
papers.abstract: Abstract The early ontogeny of endemic freshwater fishes provides essential baseline biological information for conservation and management, particularly in species with restricted distributions and high vulnerability to habitat degradation, environmental change and population decline. This study presents the first detailed description of embryonic and larval development of Tlaloc hildebrandi , an endangered (EN) killifish endemic to Chiapas, Mexico. Ontogenetic development was documented under controlled conditions from fertilisation to the completion of the larval period and the establishment of juvenile morphology at 35 days post‐hatching. Embryogenesis proceeded through a typical teleost sequence, including cleavage, blastula, gastrulation, somitogenesis and organogenesis, and was completed in approximately 12 days (300 accumulated thermal units, ATU) at 25°C. Eggs were relatively large (2.33 ± 0.03 mm) and demersal, with adhesive filaments concentrated near the micropyle. Larvae hatched at a comparatively large size (7.20 ± 0.04 mm total length) and exhibited advanced morphological features, including functional sensory systems and early feeding capability. A mixed‐feeding period persisted for approximately 5 days, after which larvae transitioned to exclusive exogenous feeding. Post‐hatching development involved progressive differentiation of cranial structures, fins, lateral line system and olfactory organs, culminating in the establishment of juvenile morphology by 35 days post‐hatching. The developmental trajectory of T. hildebrandi reflects a non‐annual life history strategy characterised by direct development, absence of diapause and high maternal investment per offspring. Large egg size, extended yolk utilisation and early feeding behaviour likely enhance larval survival in stable, high‐altitude freshwater environments. This study contributes to the knowledge of developmental biology in fishes of the Middle American family Profundulidae and provides a baseline of information for future comparative studies and conservation programs, including captive propagation, larval rearing and population monitoring.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究首次详细描述了墨西哥特有濒危鳉鱼Tlaloc hildebrandi的胚胎与仔鱼发育过程，旨在为保护与管理提供基础生物学数据。在受控条件下（25°C），胚胎发育约12天（300 ATU）完成，卵较大（2.33 mm）且沉性，具黏附丝；仔鱼孵化时全长7.20 mm，具备功能性感官和早期摄食能力，混合营养期约5天，35天后完成幼鱼形态建立。其发育轨迹反映非年周期生活史策略，表现为直接发育、无滞育和高亲代投入，大卵和延长卵黄利用有助于在稳定高海拔淡水环境中提高仔鱼存活率。该结果填补了Profundulidae科发育生物学空白，为人工繁殖、仔鱼培育及种群监测等保护工作提供参考。

papers.title: Black Carp M ylopharyngodon piceus reproductive development and maturation in the M ississippi R iver basin
papers.authors: Kroboth, Patrick T.; Herndon, Anne M.; Carlson, Cayla L.; Williams, Fred; Alvarez, Rachel N.; George, Amy E.
papers.abstract: Abstract Black Carp Mylopharyngodon piceus are native to most major east Asian drainages and are internationally cultured for use as a food‐fish or a biological control for molluscs. We describe the reproductive biology of Black Carp from the growing invasive population in the Mississippi River basin through examination of incidental commercial fisheries and biologist captures. Our objectives were to assess (1) reproductive development by combined macroscopic and histological staging to compare reproductive maturation by total length, estimated age, and latitude; (2) population functions of gonadosomatic index, length and age, and weight and length relationships; and (3) absolute fecundity. We identified length as a better predictor of reproductive maturation than age, with variation among individuals, and between males and females, with higher probability of maturation anticipated for larger and older individuals predicted around 1050 mm total length (TL; 6 years) for females and 950 mm TL (5 years) for males ( n = 548). Proposed sizes and ages are representative minimum and should be interpreted with the understanding that spawning and recruitment success increase for older, more mature fish than in early stages. Observed growth rates were rapid relative to both native and introduced ranges. We confirmed that Black Carp are developmentally indeterminate batch spawners due to the simultaneous presence of advanced growth oocytes via histology and egg measurements, with preserved egg average diameters ranging from 0.395 to 3.215 mm ( n = 23). Absolute fecundity estimates ranged from 72,748 to 3,542,789 eggs across the 966 to 1412 mm TL size range of individuals, with substantial variability among individuals attributed to poor relative fecundity estimates. These results represent the first step in assessing the reproductive rates of Mississippi River Black Carp via the size of reproductive development and potential contributions through fecundity. The results and population rates presented here may be used or adapted for future studies on regional spawning phenology and reproductive development, or in population growth models for control.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于密西西比河流域入侵性黑鲤（Black Carp *Mylopharyngodon piceus*）的兼捕与生物学家采集样本，通过宏观与组织学分期评估其繁殖发育，并分析性腺指数、体长-年龄关系及绝对繁殖力。结果显示，体长较年龄更能预测性成熟，雌鱼约在1050 mm（6龄）、雄鱼约在950 mm（5龄）时达到成熟，且生长速率快于原产地与其它引入区。组织学与卵径测量证实其为分批产卵类型，绝对繁殖力为72,748–3,542,789粒，但个体间变异大。该研究为评估密西西比河黑鲤繁殖潜力及种群控制模型提供了基础参数。

papers.title: Age and growth of the tiger shark Galeocerdo cuvier off northeastern Brazil, with evidence of habitat‐related age structure
papers.authors: Santana, Francisco Marcante; Lessa, Rosangela; Afonso, André; Hazin, Fábio H. V.; Barreto, Rodrigo
papers.abstract: Abstract A total of 221 tiger sharks ( Galeocerdo cuvier ) ranging from 82 to 426 cm total length (TL) were sampled off northeastern Brazil, including a vertebrally aged subsample of 67 individuals. Growth‐band counts ranged from 1 to 15, and agreement between readers was high (percentage error, %E = 2.1%). Marginal increment analysis did not reveal a consistent seasonal pattern in band deposition; therefore, band pairs were treated as annual for growth modelling, with the first postnatal growth‐band pair assigned an age of 0.5 years. Back‐calculated length‐at‐age data were used to evaluate alternative growth models. The von Bertalanffy growth model provided the best fit, yielding parameter estimates of L ∞ = 401.15 cm TL, k = 0.255 year −1 and t 0 = −1.077 years. Predicted TL was 165.1 cm at age 1 year and approximately 200 cm at age 1.5 years, indicating rapid juvenile growth. The age at maturity, inferred from a published maturity length of 310 cm TL, was approximately 4.7 years. Age composition differed significantly between sampling areas, with coastal samples dominated by neonates and very young juveniles, whereas oceanic samples consisted primarily of juveniles, consistent with an ontogenetic shift in habitat use. These findings provide the most comprehensive vertebra‐based growth assessment of G. cuvier from northeastern Brazil to date, reinforce previous evidence of rapid early growth in the region and demonstrate how regional context and methodological differences can influence growth estimates for this species.
papers.summary_cn: 对巴西东北部221尾虎鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier，体长82–426 cm）进行年龄与生长研究，其中67尾用于脊椎骨年龄鉴定。生长带计数为1–15，读者间误差低（%E=2.1%）；边缘增量分析未显示季节性沉积规律，故将年轮对视为年沉积，并设定首个出生后年轮对年龄为0.5年。基于反算体长-年龄数据拟合生长模型，von Bertalanffy模型最优，参数为L∞=401.15 cm TL、k=0.255 year⁻¹、t₀=−1.077年；预测1龄体长165.1 cm，1.5龄约200 cm，显示幼鱼快速生长，且由成熟体长310 cm推断的成熟年龄约4.7年。采样区域间年龄组成显著差异：近岸以新生幼鱼和极幼龄个体为主，外海则多为幼鱼，反映栖息地利用的个体发育转移。该研究为巴西东北部虎鲨提供了最全面的脊椎骨生长评估，证实该区域早期快速生长，并凸显区域背景和方法差异对生长估计的影响。

papers.title: Identifying the Drivers of Newfoundland Capelin Recruitment After a Breakdown in the Environment–Recruitment Relationship
papers.authors: Murphy, Hannah M.; Cyr, Frédéric; Adamack, Aaron T.; Robert, Dominique; Pepin, Pierre
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Environment‐recruitment relationships often break down over time. This can occur because of spurious results from testing numerous environmental variables in the original analyses or from relative changes in the importance of specific environmental drivers over time. An environment‐recruitment model was developed for the Newfoundland and Labrador capelin stock, but the relationship first weakened with the addition of new data and then recently broke down. We hypothesized that the thermal and wind parameters in the original environment‐recruitment model were now less important for recruitment dynamics following a stock collapse in 1991 due to the observed change in stock demographics, while other mechanisms like timing of spawning and annual climate conditions may be more important. Furthermore, three different measures of age‐2 recruitment were used in the original model and subsequent re‐testing of the environment‐recruitment relationships, which may have instigated a spurious breakdown of this relationship. Using a consistent empirical measure of age‐2 recruitment for the 1983–2022 year‐classes, an earlier timing in peak spawning predicted higher age‐2 recruitment, although only a moderate level of variability ( R 2 < 40%) was explained. The timing of spawning has been persistently delayed since the stock collapsed in 1991, which has had a profound impact on stock dynamics. This study demonstrates the importance of renewed and frequent reassessment of prior knowledge of stock dynamics and environment‐recruitment relationships, especially when dramatic changes in stock dynamics or ecosystem regime shifts are observed.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对纽芬兰与拉布拉多毛鳞鱼（capelin）种群在环境-补充量关系破裂后的驱动因素展开分析，旨在厘清原始模型失效原因并识别关键机制。通过统一使用1983–2022年世代年龄-2补充量的经验测量，发现产卵高峰期提前可预测更高的年龄-2补充量，但仅解释不足40%的变异（R²<40%）。自1991年种群崩溃以来，产卵时间持续推迟，对种群动态产生深远影响。研究强调，在种群动态剧变或生态系统状态转换时，需定期重新评估既有环境-补充量关系及种群动态认知。

papers.title: Prognostic Markers in Meningioma: Effectiveness of FISH‐Assessed CDKN2A/B Homozygous Deletion and Limits of Surrogate p16/MTAP Immunohistochemistry in Predicting Disease‐Specific Survival
papers.authors: Ricci, Alessia Andrea; Nozzoli, Filippo; Biale, Alessandro; Tampieri, Cristian; Verdun di Cantogno, Ludovica; Garbossa, Diego; Levis, Mario; Rudà, Roberta; Bonaudo, Camilla; Della Puppa, Alessandro
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aims Homozygous deletion (HD) of CDKN2A/B represents an adverse prognostic biomarker in meningiomas and a diagnostic criterion for CNS WHO grade 3 assignment. However, fluorescence in situ hybridisation (FISH) thresholds and the role of immunohistochemistry (IHC) surrogates remain uncertain. This study evaluated multiple CDKN2A/B FISH cutoffs and assessed the diagnostic and prognostic performance of MTAP and p16 IHC. Methods and Results Ninety‐two meningiomas (CNS WHO grades 1–3) were analysed by FISH evaluating ≥ 10%, ≥ 20% and ≥ 30% CDKN2A/B HD thresholds. CDKN2A/B HD was identified in 18.5%, 6.5% and 4.3% of cases using the respective cutoffs and was significantly associated with shorter disease‐specific survival across all thresholds (HD ≥ 10% p = 0.001 ; HD ≥ 20% p = 0.0001; HD ≥ 30% p = 0.043). Patients with HD ≥ 20% and ≥ 30% experienced universal disease‐specific mortality within a median survival time of approximately 2 years. MTAP and p16 IHC were performed in matched areas. MTAP IHC showed high specificity (90%–92%) but limited sensitivity (30%–50%), while p16 IHC displayed variable sensitivity (41%–75%) and lower specificity (63%). Combined MTAP/p16 negativity improved sensitivity (up to 100%) but reduced specificity (57%). Neither MTAP nor p16 loss correlated significantly with survival. Spatially heterogeneous IHC patterns corresponded to regional variability in CDKN2A/B deletion by FISH. Conclusions CDKN2A/B HD detected by FISH, particularly using thresholds equal or greater than 20%, is strongly associated with poor outcome in meningiomas. MTAP and p16 IHC, alone or combined, lack sufficient accuracy as independent surrogates but may guide tissue selection for molecular testing in heterogeneous tumours.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估了FISH检测CDKN2A/B纯合缺失（HD）在脑膜瘤中的预后价值，并比较了MTAP和p16免疫组化（IHC）作为替代标志物的效能。92例脑膜瘤分析显示，HD≥20%阈值与疾病特异性生存显著相关（p=0.0001），患者中位生存期约2年。MTAP IHC特异性高（90%-92%）但敏感性有限（30%-50%），p16 IHC敏感性变异大（41%-75%）且特异性较低（63%），两者联合虽提高敏感性但降低特异性。结论认为FISH检测HD（尤其≥20%阈值）是强预后指标，IHC替代标志物准确性不足，但可辅助异质性肿瘤的组织选择。

papers.title: A Multidimensional Approach to α- and β-Diversity of Fish Assemblages in Tropical Estuaries Under Semiarid Influence
papers.authors: da Silva Lima, Caroline Stefani; Pessanha, André Luiz Machado
papers.abstract: Abstract Functional adaptations enable estuarine fishes to exploit habitats along environmental gradients. This study investigated how geomorphological and anthropogenic features of three tropical Brazilian estuaries within semi-arid river basins (Mamanguape, Paraíba, and Gramame) influence the taxonomic, functional, and phylogenetic diversity of fish assemblages during rainy and dry seasons. A total of 11,073 individuals from 118 species and 33 families were recorded. The assemblage was dominated by schooling, zoobenthivorous, fusiform, marine estuarine-dependent, and pelagic traits. We found that: (1) putative seasonality increases taxonomic β-diversity and decreases taxonomic α-diversity, likely due to intensified environmental filtering along estuarine gradients during periods of higher freshwater flow; (2) larger, permanently open estuaries showed β-diversity dominance, whereas the smaller, intermittently closed estuary exhibited α-diversity dominance; and (3) estuaries characterized by smaller mouth widths showed homogenization of species, functions, and lineages, reflecting low functional redundancy and increased vulnerability. Overall, our results show that integrating multiple diversity facets can support stronger connections with conservation priorities for estuarine fish biodiversity, highlighting the value of a multimetric approach in estuaries influenced by a semiarid climate.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用多维多样性框架，探究半干旱流域三个热带巴西河口（Mamanguape、Paraíba和Gramame）的地貌与人为特征如何影响鱼类群落的分类、功能和系统发育多样性。基于118种33科11,073尾样本，发现雨季淡水输入增强环境过滤，提高分类β多样性并降低α多样性；大型永久开放河口以β多样性为主，而小型间歇封闭河口以α多样性为主，且河口宽度较小的系统呈现物种、功能和谱系同质化，功能冗余度低、脆弱性高。研究表明，整合多维度多样性指标可强化河口鱼类生物多样性与保护优先级的关联，凸显多指标方法在半干旱气候影响河口中的价值。

papers.title: Beyond red meat: fish roe-associated reactions in patients with alpha-gal syndrome—a case series from Sri Lanka
papers.authors: Badanasinghe, Chamini Nadisha; Suriapperuma, Tharindi; de Silva, Suraj Roshitha; Bolarugoda, Vinuri Chamathka; Madhushanka, Wickramarachchilage Dinuka Shehan; Salpitikorala, Eumini; Weeraratne, Athula Chandana
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Alpha-gal syndrome (AGS) is an IgE-mediated allergy to galactose-α-1,3-galactose (α-Gal), classically presenting with delayed allergic reactions after ingestion of mammalian-derived foods. Fish roe has recently emerged as a potential but under-recognized trigger in α-Gal-sensitized individuals. We describe the first South Asian case series of three patients with AGS who developed anaphylaxis following fish roe ingestion, highlighting this atypical trigger as a possible emerging cause of anaphylaxis associated with AGS in the region. Case presentation We retrospectively reviewed patients evaluated at a tertiary allergy clinic in Sri Lanka between January 2025 and May 2026 who developed allergic reactions following fish roe ingestion and fulfilled the diagnostic criteria for AGS based on a compatible clinical history, positive skin prick testing, elevated serum α-Gal-specific IgE, and symptom resolution following dietary avoidance. Three women aged 19, 45, and 53 years presented with anaphylaxis 5minutes to 1 hour after fish roe ingestion. All had clinical features suggestive of AGS, including delayed reactions to mammalian meat, gastrointestinal symptoms following dairy consumption, recurrent unexplained allergic episodes, and a history of tick exposure. Skin prick testing demonstrated sensitization to fish roe and mammalian-derived allergens, while serum α-Gal-specific IgE concentrations ranged from 1.55 to 12.7 kUA/L. Oral food challenges were not performed because of the risk of severe reactions. Following avoidance of mammalian meat, dairy products, gelatin and fish roe all patients remained free of further allergic reactions during follow-up. Conclusions Fish roe may represent an important and under-recognized trigger of immediate anaphylaxis in patients with AGS. Recognition of this atypical presentation is essential for timely diagnosis, appropriate dietary counselling, and prevention of recurrent life-threatening reactions. Larger mechanistic and epidemiological studies are needed to determine the prevalence and elucidate the underlying pathophysiological mechanisms of fish roe-associated reactions in AGS.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次在南亚报道了3例α-gal综合征（AGS）患者因摄入鱼卵而诱发速发型过敏反应的病例系列。患者均为女性（19、45、53岁），在摄入鱼卵后5分钟至1小时内出现过敏性休克，且伴有哺乳动物肉类迟发反应、乳制品胃肠道症状及蜱虫暴露史。皮肤点刺试验证实对鱼卵及哺乳动物源性过敏原敏感，血清α-Gal特异性IgE水平为1.55–12.7 kUA/L。研究提示鱼卵可能是AGS患者中易被忽视的重要过敏触发因素，临床识别该非典型表现对及时诊断和饮食指导至关重要。

papers.title: Comparative Ecotoxicological Impacts of Traditional and Emerging Microplastics on Marine Zooplankton: Implications for Aquaculture and Coastal Ecosystem Health
papers.authors: Munna, Raj Mahmood; Bulbul, Rassel Mahmood
papers.abstract: Marine ecosystem health is threatened by an increasing worldwide problem when microplastic pollution occurs. The emerging microplastics (MPs), such as biodegradable bioplastics, tire wear particles (TWPs), and synthetic microfibers, introduce distinct risk profiles compared to well-studied legacy petroleum-based polymers (polystyrene, polyethylene, polypropylene). Marine zooplankton serve as vital primary consumers and key energy links to higher trophic levels, including species of economic importance for aquaculture. This review summarises the current scientific knowledge on the ingestion mechanisms, tissue deposition, and multi-level ecotoxicological effects of traditional and emerging microplastics on marine zooplankton communities. Physiological and physical disruption due to microplastic exposure, such as oxidative stress cascade, neurotoxicity, due to enzyme inhibition, endocrine disruption, and reproductive failure, are discussed. In addition, persistent organic pollutants (POPs) and heavy metals (the “Trojan Horse” effect) are analysed alongside the leaching kinetics of toxic endogenous additives (e.g., phthalates, bisphenols, 6PPD-quinone). Finally, we address the trophic transfer of these particles into coastal aquaculture systems, which negatively affects the seafood safety, sustainability and biological carbon pump, while presenting structural mitigation and legislative solutions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统比较了传统与新型微塑料（如可降解生物塑料、轮胎磨损颗粒及合成微纤维）对海洋浮游动物的生态毒理效应，重点关注其摄入机制、组织沉积及多层级毒性影响。综述揭示了微塑料暴露引发的氧化应激、神经毒性、内分泌干扰和繁殖障碍等生理损伤，并分析了持久性有机污染物与重金属的“特洛伊木马”效应及内源添加剂的浸出动力学。研究还探讨了微塑料通过营养级传递进入沿海 aquaculture 系统对海产品安全、可持续性和生物碳泵的负面影响，并提出了结构性缓解与立法解决方案。

papers.title: The Effectiveness of <i>Gracilaria</i> sp. as a Biofilter in Reducing Aquaculture Waste Based on Planting Location in the Waters of Ujung Betok, East Lombok
papers.authors: Dwiyanti, Septiana; Setyono, Bagus Dwi Hari; Dermawan, Awan; Sumsanto, Muhammad; Marzuki, Muhammad; Ramdani, Arman Ainul
papers.abstract: Aquaculture waste can increase dissolved inorganic nutrient concentrations, making seaweed-based treatment an important component of integrated biological nutrient management. This study aimed to evaluate strategic planting locations of Gracilaria sp. around floating net cages and assess its effectiveness as a natural biofilter for reducing nitrogenous waste in Ujung Betok waters, East Lombok. A Completely Randomized Design (CRD) was applied with three planting-distance treatments and three replicates. Total Ammonia Nitrogen (TAN) concentrations ranged from 0.29–0.31 mg/L at the beginning and 0.24–0.29 mg/L at the end of the 30-day culture period. ANOVA showed no significant difference in initial TAN among treatments (p = 0.868), whereas final TAN differed significantly among planting locations (p = 0.001). Final total nitrogen content in Gracilaria sp. tissue ranged from 0.287–0.330%, with the highest value in T2 (0.330 ± 0.050%), followed by T3 (0.303 ± 0.006%) and T1 (0.287 ± 0.015%). Planting location did not significantly affect tissue total nitrogen content (p > 0.05). Tissue nitrogen reduction was 13.03% in T1, 0.00% in T2, and 8.18% in T3. TAN reduction was highest in T1, decreasing from 0.31 to 0.24 mg/L or 22.58%, followed by T2 at 3.33%, while T3 showed no reduction. These results indicate that Gracilaria sp. can contribute to nitrogen removal, with the 25 m planting location showing the best biofiltration performance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在东龙目岛Ujung Betok水域评估了不同种植距离下Gracilaria sp.作为生物滤器对网箱养殖废水中氮的去除效果。采用完全随机设计（CRD）设置3个种植距离处理，经30天培养后，总氨氮（TAN）浓度从初始0.29–0.31 mg/L降至0.24–0.29 mg/L，其中25 m种植位置（T1）的TAN去除率最高达22.58%，组织氮含量为0.287–0.330%。ANOVA显示最终TAN在不同种植位置间差异显著（p = 0.001），但组织总氮含量无显著差异（p > 0.05）。结果表明Gracilaria sp.可有效去除养殖氮废物，25 m种植距离表现出最佳biofilter性能。

papers.title: Divergent Environmental Niches and Climate Vulnerabilities of Jonah Crab ( Cancer borealis ) and Atlantic Rock Crab ( Cancer irroratus )
papers.authors: Rzeszowski, Everett J.; Krasnow, Ruby; Brady, Damian C.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Jonah crab and Atlantic rock crab in the United States are currently assessed by National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration climate change vulnerability assessments under the category Cancer crabs due to a dearth of species‐specific information across the attributes assessed. These species are frequently bycatch in the American lobster fishery and have low landed volume in comparison to larger Northeast US commercial fisheries. Here, we developed species distribution models using abundance, bottom temperature, and bottom salinity from Northeast Fishery Science Center Bottom Trawl data and calculated species‐specific environmental suitability indices. We used interpolated data to hindcast (1992–2024) environmental suitability in the five Jonah crab stocks for each species. Then, using similar methods, environmental suitability was forecasted from bottom temperature and bottom salinity conditions from 2075 to 2094 under RCP 8.5 climate conditions. This analysis found that Jonah crab occupies a narrow, stable niche, with optimal temperatures of 9°C–12°C in both seasons and habitat 150–350 m deeper than Atlantic rock crab, while Atlantic rock crab tolerates far larger swings, with the OSNE stock shifting optimal temperature by 11°C (5°C to 16°C) and salinity by 7 units between spring and fall. By identifying these differences, we show that Jonah crab's narrower thermal and salinity tolerance likely makes it more sensitive to climate change than the broadly tolerant Atlantic rock crab, refining species‐specific inputs for climate change vulnerability assessments and each species' potential as a long‐term fishery target.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于美国东北渔业科学中心底拖网数据，构建物种分布模型，结合底温与底盐，评估黄道蟹（Cancer borealis）和 Atlantic rock crab（Cancer irroratus）的环境适宜性，并预测RCP 8.5气候情景下2075–2094年的变化。结果显示，黄道蟹占据狭窄稳定生态位，最适温度9–12°C，栖息深度较Atlantic rock crab深150–350米；后者耐受性更广，其OSNE种群春季至秋季最适温度变化达11°C、盐度变化7个单位。研究表明，黄道蟹对气候变化的敏感性高于Atlantic rock crab，为 NOAA 的气候脆弱性评估及长期渔业开发潜力提供了物种特异性依据。

papers.title: Ovarian fluid is associated with distinct sperm RNA profiles and enhanced swimming performance in a teleost fish
papers.authors: Nowicki, Alexandra E; Butts, Ian A E
papers.abstract: Abstract For most externally fertilizing teleost fish, sperm remain immotile until release into the external environment, where physicochemical cues trigger motility. In many species, including blue catfish (Ictalurus furcatus), ovarian fluid (OF) present at spawning further enhances sperm swimming performance, enabling more cells to swim longer and at higher velocities than in water alone. This study aimed to identify kinematic performance and RNA profiles associated with sperm-environment interactions under three conditions: (i) sperm activated with 25% OF and 75% deionized water (dH2O) (OF-enhanced); (ii) sperm combined with 100% OF (inactive); and (iii) sperm activated with 100% dH2O (control). We utilized computer assisted sperm analysis in combination with RNA-sequencing to examine sperm kinematics and transcript abundance between sperm-environments. CASA results showed that sperm activated in OF (OF-enhanced) had increased sperm motility and velocity compared to sperm activated in water alone (control). Variance component analysis further identified a male × female interaction associated with variation in sperm swimming performance. RNA-sequencing revealed distinct transcript abundance patterns among sperm environments and also revealed female-associated variation in transcript abundance, providing evidence for gamete level variation on sperm performance. Functional enrichment analysis further revealed that abundant transcripts in the OF treatments were associated with cytoskeletal organization, signaling, large multi-protein complexes, and membrane-associated processes. This study provides novel observations of OF-associated sperm RNA profiles and enhanced swimming performance in a teleost fish, generating hypotheses regarding underlying molecular mechanisms of sperm activation and reaction to environmental stimuli.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以蓝鲶鱼（Ictalurus furcatus）为对象，探讨卵巢液（OF）对精子运动性能和RNA表达谱的影响。通过计算机辅助精子分析（CASA）和RNA测序，比较了25% OF激活、100% OF（非激活）及纯水激活三种条件下的精子运动学与转录组特征。结果显示，OF激活显著提升精子活力和速度，且存在雄性×雌性交互效应影响游泳性能；RNA测序揭示OF处理组富集细胞骨架组织、信号传导及膜相关过程的转录本。研究首次报道了硬骨鱼OF相关精子RNA谱与运动增强的关联，为精子激活的分子机制提供了新假说。

papers.title: Post‐release survival, movement and marine migration of smolt‐to‐adult supplemented Atlantic Salmon
papers.authors: Koopman, Natalie C.; Lennox, Robert J.; Piczak, Morgan L.; Stubbings, Marin; Penney, Sarah; Batt, John; Crossin, Glenn T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ) populations are declining across much of their range, prompting the use of supplementation strategies, such as smolt‐to‐adult supplementation (SAS), to enhance adult returns. However, little is known about how captivity while maturing to adulthood influences post‐release survival, behaviour and migration of salmonids. This study evaluated SAS as a conservation approach by using acoustic telemetry to assess survival, freshwater movement, river exit timing, acceleration activity and marine migration of SAS salmon released into Clyburn Brook, Cape Breton Highlands National Park, Canada. Wild adult salmon from the nearby Chéticamp River were also tagged to provide a regional comparison for overwintering and marine movements of SAS salmon, but differences in spawning state at tagging and population specific life‐history traits (e.g., spawn timing, marine distribution) limited direct behavioural comparisons. SAS salmon had 53% freshwater mortality and exhibited elevated acceleration activity, frequent high‐energy bursts, lack of upriver movement and premature river exit. Notably, SAS salmon held in captivity for 2 years had higher survival than those held for 1 year, but they exhibited little upstream movement, raising concerns of whether any spawning activity occurred. In contrast, SAS salmon held for 1 year had higher mortality, but more moved upstream toward presumed spawning areas prior to final detection, suggesting potential spawning opportunities. Wild Chéticamp River salmon had a large marine distribution route through the Gulf of St. Lawrence and north to Labrador, whereas SAS salmon were detected regionally in the Atlantic Ocean off Cape Breton, including St. Ann's Bank Marine Protected Area and Sable Island. Contrasting marine distributions likely reflect intrinsic population differences rather than effects of SAS rearing alone. Our findings highlight the complex effects of adult captivity on post‐release survival and movement in Atlantic salmon, and underscore the need for further research to refine SAS management approaches, including consideration of captivity duration, feeding strategies and release locations.
papers.summary_cn: 大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）种群普遍衰退，促使采用smolt-to-adult supplementation（SAS）策略增加成鱼回归，但成体期圈养对其放流后存活、行为及洄游的影响尚不明确。本研究在加拿大Clyburn Brook利用声学遥测评估SAS鲑的淡水存活、运动、出河时机及海洋迁移，并与野生Chéticamp河鲑比较。结果显示，SAS鲑淡水死亡率为53%，表现出高加速度活动、频繁高能爆发、缺乏上溯运动及提前出河；圈养2年个体存活率高于1年者，但上溯运动极少，而1年圈养者死亡率较高但更多个体向产卵区移动。海洋分布上，野生鲑经圣劳伦斯湾至拉布拉多，SAS鲑则限于Cape Breton近海（含St. Ann's Bank MPA和Sable Island），差异可能源于种群固有特性而非圈养效应。研究强调成体圈养对放流后存活和运动的复杂影响，需进一步优化SAS管理（圈养时长、投喂策略及放流地点）。

papers.title: Fishers’ Knowledge Reveals Spatio-Temporal Dynamics of Billfish Sport and Tourist Fisheries on the Pacific Coast of Costa Rica
papers.authors: Berkowitz-Sklar, Daviana; Marín Sandoval, Henry; Bates, Danielle; Blondin, Hannah; Early Capistrán, Michelle María; Schmitz, Oswald; Crowder, Larry B.
papers.abstract: Introduction: Addressing ecological and social knowledge gaps is essential for the sustainable management of recreational fisheries. Costa Rica is internationally recognized as a premier sport fishing destination, particularly for billfish such as sailfish (Istiophorus platypterus) and blue marlin (Makaira nigricans). Despite their socioeconomic importance, major knowledge gaps remain in the dynamics of sport and tourist fisheries, hindering effective management. Fishers involved in tourist and sport fishing can provide valuable social-ecological insights into their fisheries and target species. Objectives: This paper seeks to identify the spatio-temporal patterns of billfish sport and tourist fishing activity along the Pacific coast of Costa Rica and to assess regional differences shaped by social and ecological factors, drawing on the knowledge and perceptions of fishers. Methods: We conducted semi-structured interviews with sport fishing captains (n=62) from private and charter operations across eight Pacific coast communities: Golfito and Puerto Jimenez in the Southern Pacific (n = 14); Quepos and Herradura in the Central Pacific (n = 34); and Tamarindo, Flamingo, Cuajiniquil, and El Jobo in the Northern Pacific (n = 14). Interviews included a participatory mapping activity to identify key fishing grounds for sailfish and blue marlin, along with a standardized questionnaire on fisher demographics, fishing seasonality, billfish and non-billfish species caught on the most recent trip (and their reported abundance), offshore distances of their most recent trip, and changes in fishing equipment and technology over time. Results: Analyses of fisher responses revealed nearshore fishing hotspots within 60 nautical miles of the Pacific coast of Costa Rica and regional differences in fishing seasonality, likely shaped by both oceanographic variability and tourism. Based on reported values, the Central Pacific exhibited the highest mean releases of sailfish and blue marlin and longest mean offshore distances in their most recent trip, compared to fishers operating in the Northern and Southern Pacific. Fishers in the Northern and Central Pacific reported overall improvements in fishing equipment and technology. Conclusions: These findings underscore the value of integrating fishers’ knowledge into fisheries research, enabling the management of billfish fisheries of Costa Rica to better reflect region-specific fishery dynamics. By capturing fishers’ lived experiences and observations, this study supports a participatory approach to billfish fisheries management in Costa Rica.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过访谈哥斯达黎加太平洋沿岸8个社区62名运动钓鱼船长，结合参与式绘图与标准化问卷，揭示旗鱼类（sailfish和blue marlin）休闲渔业时空动态。结果显示，捕捞热点集中于离岸60海里内，中部太平洋区域在旗鱼释放量和离岸距离上显著高于南北部，且季节性与海洋变率和旅游业相关。研究证实渔民知识可有效补充生态数据缺口，为区域差异化管理和参与式渔业治理提供科学依据。

papers.title: Reservoir Patchiness Influences Fish Condition: Khor-Scale Heterogeneity in Lake Nasser (Egypt) and Implications for Global Inland Fisheries
papers.authors: Younis, Alaa M.; AbouelFadl, Khaled Y.; Mohammed-Geba, Khaled; Hamed-Mohamed, Doaa; Khaled, Mostafa A.
papers.abstract: Global inland fisheries depend on large reservoirs, yet many assessments assume spatial homogeneity despite complex embayed morphometry. We tested whether khor-scale structure within Lake Nasser, Egypt, explains variation in two commercially important catfishes. Six distinct khors spanning the north–south axis (Ghazal, Sheniara, Garf Hussein, Amada, Toshka, and Hamedo) were sampled with standardized effort (72 net-nights; 12 per khor, 3 representative areas ≥ 500 m apart × 4 campaigns, March–June 2021), yielding 398 fish (268 Chrysichthysauratus, 130 C. rueppelli). Abundance was expressed as standardized CPUE (fish·net-night−1). C. auratus CPUE ranged from 2.83 (Ghazal) to 5.92 (Garf Hussein), while C. rueppelli CPUE was relatively uniform (1.50–1.92). C. auratus attained the largest TL in Ghazal (25.51 ± 2.9 cm) and the highest condition K in Garf Hussein (1.46 ± 0.18). C. rueppelli attained the greatest TL and weight in southern khors, especially Hamedo (23.3 ± 2.33 cm, 146.7 ± 30.5 g), while its highest condition was in Toshka (1.30 ± 0.15). Sex ratio was significantly female-biased for C. auratus (92 M:176 F, 1:1.91, p < 0.001) but not for C. rueppelli (55 M:75 F, 1:1.36, p = 0.079). Results show embayment-scale CPUE and condition, not whole-lake means, capture key population patterns, improving precision of mega-reservoir fisheries management.
papers.summary_cn: 全球内陆渔业依赖大型水库，但多数评估假设空间均质，忽视了复杂库湾形态。本研究在埃及纳赛尔湖6个南北向khor（库湾）以标准化努力量采样两种商业鲶鱼，检验库湾尺度异质性对鱼类状况的影响。结果显示，Chrysichthys auratus的CPUE和条件因子K在khor间差异显著（2.83–5.92 fish·net-night⁻¹；K最高1.46），而C. rueppelli相对均匀；前者性比显著偏雌（1:1.91），后者不显著。研究表明，库湾尺度的CPUE和条件指标优于全湖均值，可提升巨型水库渔业管理的精度。

papers.title: Parental senescence effects in a short-lived fish
papers.authors: Vrtílek, Milan; Kromerová, Anna; Šinková, Rebeka; Fojtová, Miloslava; Dianat, Malahat; Fajkus, Jiří
papers.abstract: Abstract Senescence is age-related decline that may carry over to subsequent generations. Advanced parental age can both improve or reduce offspring fitness, however. Identification of mechanisms of parental effects senescence thus proved challenging so far. We investigated the effects of old parental age on offspring performance in a laboratory short-lived fish, Nothobranchius furzeri (Cyprinodontiformes). We followed age-related changes in parents and then focused on the effect of parental age on key offspring life-history traits (embryonic survival, hatching rate and juvenile growth). We employed telomere length as a senescence marker and a potential route for transmitting senescence effects from parents to the offspring. As parents aged, their body condition, reproductive output, and telomere length declined. Offspring of older parents showed lower survival and hatching rate. In contrast, old parental age did not compromise juvenile growth and telomere length of the successfully hatched offspring. This, among other things, resulted in decoupling of parent-offspring telomere length. Our study highlights the sensitivity of the early life-stages to old parental age in contrast to offspring post-hatching performance.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以短寿命鱼类非洲鳉鱼（Nothobranchius furzeri）为对象，探讨亲本衰老对后代适合度的影响。通过追踪亲本年龄相关变化，并测定后代胚胎存活率、孵化率及幼鱼生长等生活史性状，同时以端粒长度作为衰老标记。结果显示，高龄亲本体况、繁殖输出和端粒长度下降，其后代存活率和孵化率降低，但幼鱼生长及端粒长度未受影响，导致亲本与后代端粒长度解耦。研究表明早期生活阶段对亲本衰老更为敏感，而孵化后表现不受影响。

papers.title: Comparative performance of DNA and peptide-based methods for fish gelatin detection in commercial products
papers.authors: Soycan, Adem; Bilgin, Mustafa
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了DNA与多肽检测方法在商业鱼明胶产品鉴定中的表现，旨在评估两种技术的适用性与可靠性。方法涵盖DNA扩增及多肽质谱分析，针对不同加工处理的产品进行验证。主要发现DNA法灵敏度高但受降解影响，多肽法更稳定且适用于深度加工样品。结论建议根据产品加工程度选择合适检测策略，以提升鱼种溯源准确性。

papers.title: High-throughput 16S rRNA sequencing reveals gut dysbiosis and linked hepatic toxicity in triflumezopyrim treated juvenile freshwater fish Labeo rohita
papers.authors: Mishra, Bhabani; Nayak, Sipra; Mohanty, Aman Kumar; Das, Ipsita Iswari; Rakkannan, Gowrimanohari; Sahoo, Lakshman; Kumar, Rajesh; Sundaray, Jitendra Kumar
papers.journal: World Journal of Microbiology and Biotechnology
papers.summary_cn: 基于16S rRNA高通量测序，本研究探讨了三氟甲吡醚对淡水鱼Labeo rohita幼鱼肠道菌群失调及肝脏毒性的关联机制。结果显示，该农药暴露诱导肠道微生物群落结构显著改变，并伴随肝损伤标志物升高，提示肠道菌群失衡可能介导肝脏毒性。研究为评估三氟甲吡醚的生态毒理风险提供了分子生态学证据。

papers.title: First Report and Integrated Characterization of Aeromonas veronii Associated with the Protected Fish Diptychus maculatus in Xinjiang, China
papers.authors: Hamid, Syeda Maira; Lu, Huale; Hao, Huimin; Zhang, Kaipeng; Zhu, Wentao; Wei, Jie; Nie, Zhulan
papers.abstract: Aeromonas veronii is a widely distributed opportunistic aquatic pathogen associated with diseases in freshwater fish. Despite the ecological and conservation significance of Diptychus maculatus, a protected cold-water fish inhabiting high-altitude ecosystems, information regarding its associated bacterial communities remains limited. This study aimed to isolate and characterize A. veronii recovered from D. maculatus and provide baseline information on its occurrence and phenotypic characteristics. Eight bacterial isolates were recovered from various tissues, including skin, gills, eye, intestine, dorsal fin, body kidney, gonad, and spleen of randomly sampled fish individuals from Xinjiang, China. Phenotypic and biochemical characterization, together with 16S rRNA sequencing, supported their identification as A. veronii, while gyrB analysis of a representative isolate provided additional species-level confirmation. Antimicrobial susceptibility testing revealed a consistent multidrug-resistance phenotype among all isolates. The isolates were susceptible to enrofloxacin, cefotaxime, ceftriaxone, and florfenicol. Intermediate responses were observed for ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin, doxycycline, oxytetracycline, and trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole, whereas resistance was detected against norfloxacin, neomycin, penicillin, amoxicillin, tetracycline, and erythromycin. In vitro biofilm assays demonstrated weak to moderate biofilm-forming capacity among isolates. These findings provide baseline data for wildlife microbial surveillance and conservation-oriented monitoring of protected fish populations, supporting future investigations into environmental monitoring, genomic characterization, and host–microbe interactions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次从新疆保护性冷水鱼斑重唇鱼（Diptychus maculatus）多种组织中分离并鉴定出维氏气单胞菌（Aeromonas veronii），通过表型、生化特征及16S rRNA和gyrB基因测序确认物种身份。药敏试验显示所有分离株呈多重耐药表型，对恩诺沙星、头孢噻肟等敏感，对诺氟沙星、青霉素等耐药；体外生物膜试验表明其具有弱至中等成膜能力。研究为保护鱼类的微生物监测和保护导向管理提供了基础数据，并支持后续环境监测与宿主-微生物互作研究。

papers.title: Fish mtDNA COI sequences from local fish markets in the Red Sea and Arabian Sea: A reference dataset
papers.authors: Jiménez Cano, Nayeli G.; Dettaï, Agnès; Mansoor Al-Nabhani, Hanan; Abu El-Regal, Mohamed; Al-Jabri, Azzah; Béarez, Philippe
papers.abstract: This data paper describes a dataset of mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase subunit I (COI) sequences from 51 fish specimens obtained from local fish markets in eight coastal localities in Oman and Saudi Arabia. For each vouchered specimen, basic metadata such as locality, date of purchase, and morphometric data was documented, and a photographic record was made. Tissue samples were collected for DNA analysis. The COI gene was amplified and sequenced using standard DNA protocols. The resulting COI sequences were curated and deposited in the Barcode of Life Data System (BOLD). The dataset enhances the genetic representation of marine fishes from the Red Sea and Arabian Sea and adds three novel fish COI records in BOLD, Plectropomus marisrubri , Scarus zufar , and Scorpaenopsis lactomaculata , as well as numerous fish taxa which are currently poorly documented. These sequences represent a reference resource for specimen identification and verification, and can be used to underpin taxonomic revisions, comparative phylogenetic and phylogeographic studies, assessments of regional biodiversity and sea food authentication.
