In making these data freely available, this contribution promotes reproducibility, data reuse, and collaboration among researchers working on marine ecology, conservation, and fisheries management, as well as monitoring and consumer protection.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于阿曼和沙特阿拉伯8个沿海地区鱼市采集的51个鱼类样本，构建了线粒体COI基因参考数据集。通过标准DNA测序流程获取序列，并整合形态与影像数据存入BOLD系统。该数据集新增了3个BOLD新记录种（Plectropomus marisrubri、Scarus zufar、Scorpaenopsis lactomaculata）及多个记录匮乏的分类单元，显著提升了红海与阿拉伯海鱼类的遗传代表性。这些序列可作为物种鉴定与验证的参考资源，支撑分类修订、系统发育与生物地理研究、区域生物多样性评估及海产品真伪鉴别，并促进海洋生态、保护与渔业管理领域的科研协作。

papers.title: Survey of Chemical Contaminants in Wild Caught Fish, Crustaceans and Cephalopods England and Wales 2025-26
papers.summary_cn: 针对2025-26年英格兰和威尔士野生捕捞鱼类、甲壳类及头足类动物的化学污染物进行调查，旨在评估其体内污染物水平及食品安全风险。研究覆盖多种商业捕捞物种，检测重金属、持久性有机污染物等指标，为渔业管理及消费者健康保护提供基础数据。

papers.title: Spatial Assessment of Inland Water Resources and Aquaculture Development Potential in Nigeria’s Six Geopolitical Zones
papers.authors: Ogbuagu, Samuel Ifeanyi; Godwin, Oluwaseyi Ezekiel; Abeni, Olaniyi Ajibola; Chinedu, Nwangwu Desmond; Ogundeji, Obadara Emmanuel; Chindo, Jimkuta
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: This study assessed the spatial relationship between inland water resources, bioclimatic conditions, and aquaculture development across Nigeria's six geopolitical zones. Geospatial datasets from the Joint Research Centre Global Surface Water, Global Mangrove Watch, WorldClim, administrative boundaries, and national aquaculture records were integrated in QGIS and standardised to WGS 84 / UTM Zone 32N. Hydrological features were topologically corrected, fragmented into single-part polygons, and aggregated by geopolitical zone, while zonal climate statistics and aquaculture production indicators were compared using the Inland Water Dependency Index, Permanent Water Dependency Index, and Total Aquaculture Density Index. Marked regional differences were observed. The South South had the largest inland-water and wetland resources and the highest average aquaculture production (117,916 Mt), whereas the North Central contained the largest permanent-water area (2,199.37 km²) but recorded a lower average production of 58,681 Mt. The South East and South West showed the highest aquaculture density relative to available water resources, while the North East recorded the lowest Total Aquaculture Density Index (6.02). Northern zones were characterised by greater thermal variability and pronounced dry-season precipitation deficits, whereas southern zones had higher rainfall and more extensive aquatic environments. Overall, the findings indicate that aquaculture development is spatially uneven and reflects interactions among water availability, climate, production infrastructure, and competing resource uses. The framework provides a reproducible basis for regionally differentiated aquaculture planning in Nigeria.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用GIS空间分析与多源地理数据集，评估尼日利亚六大 geopolitical zones 的内陆水资源、生物气候条件与水产养殖发展的空间关系。通过构建Inland Water Dependency Index、Permanent Water Dependency Index及Total Aquaculture Density Index等指标，发现区域差异显著：South South水资源最丰富且平均产量最高（117,916 Mt），North Central永久水域面积最大但产量较低，North East养殖密度指数最低（6.02）。研究表明水产养殖发展空间不均，受水资源、气候、生产设施及资源竞争共同影响，该框架可为尼日利亚区域差异化养殖规划提供可复制的决策依据。

papers.title: Mapped Aquaculture Land-Cover Dynamics in Coastal Ecuador, 1985–2024: Registry Correspondence, Recent Transitions, and Climatic Context
papers.authors: Guarda, Teresa
papers.abstract: Reliable aquaculture monitoring requires spatial, administrative, and environmental evidence to be integrated without treating these sources as equivalent. This study characterized mapped aquaculture land-cover dynamics in six coastal provinces of Ecuador from 1985 to 2024, assessed their 2023 correspondence with authorized or concessioned shrimp-farm area, quantified 2023–2024 land-cover transitions, and described climate exposure over a fixed historical aquaculture footprint. Annual MapBiomas Ecuador Collection 3.0 classifications were aggregated by province, canton, and parish; MPCEIP records were harmonized with INEC administrative codes; and CHIRPS v3 precipitation and ERA5-Land temperature were summarized over the union of all pixels mapped as aquaculture at least once during the study period. Mapped class 31 area increased from 58,198.792 ha in 1985 to 138,200.970 ha in 2024, with a maximum of 153,516.642 ha in 2022. In 2023, mapped area represented 74.508% of 202,114.900 ha of authorized or concessioned area, with strong canton-level rank correspondence. Between 2023 and 2024, persistence reached 135,774.430 ha, gross loss 14,816.766 ha, gross gain 2426.130 ha, and net change −12,390.636 ha. Climate exposure was wettest in 1998 and warmest in 2023. Together, the results show that coastal aquaculture development cannot be inferred reliably from a single territorial measure: long-term mapped expansion, administrative extent, recent classification changes, and climate exposure describe complementary but non-equivalent dimensions of the system. This distinction provides a more defensible basis for interpreting aquaculture land-use change and for targeting territorial monitoring and administrative verification.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用MapBiomas Ecuador Collection 3.0年度分类数据，分析了1985–2024年厄瓜多尔六个沿海省份的水产养殖土地覆盖动态，并与2023年官方授权或特许养殖面积进行对应性校验。结果显示，养殖面积从1985年的58,198.792 ha增至2024年的138,200.970 ha，2023年制图面积占行政授权面积的74.508%；2023–2024年间净变化为−12,390.636 ha，气候暴露以1998年最湿、2023年最暖。研究表明，长期扩张、行政范围、近期转变及气候暴露反映系统不同维度，不可相互替代，为水产养殖土地利用变化解释及监管验证提供了更可靠依据。

papers.title: Towards the Establishment of a Sea Urchin Sperm Biobank: Key Challenges and Opportunities for the Conservation and Sustainable Aquaculture of Paracentrotus lividus
papers.authors: Antenucci, Emanuele; Di Iorio, Michele; Santoianni, Celeste; Mastronardi, Amedea; Cofelice, Martina; Lopez, Francesco; Rosati, Sebastiano; Maiuro, Lucia; Sorrentino, Elena; Carone, Giulia
papers.abstract: The Mediterranean Sea urchin Paracentrotus lividus is a key benthic herbivore and a valuable fishery resource because of the high commercial and gastronomic value of its edible gonads. Increasing market demand, overharvesting, climate change, habitat degradation, and pollution have contributed to the decline of wild populations in several Mediterranean areas. This narrative review, including a preliminary case study, provides an integrated perspective on the role of P. lividus in conservation-oriented aquaculture, with particular attention to Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA), microbiological quality, sperm quality assessment, cryopreservation, and germplasm biobanking. IMTA may improve nutrient recycling and resource-use efficiency, whereas cryopreservation and biobanking can support genetic resource conservation, selective breeding, hatchery production, and future restocking programs. Within this framework, the ongoing AVATIM project (“Virtuous Aquaculture in Integrated Marine Multitrophic Aquaculture”) is presented as an operational case study illustrating how reproductive biotechnology may be integrated into sustainable multitrophic aquaculture and germplasm conservation strategies. Baseline sperm quality parameters of sexually mature males collected from the southern Adriatic Sea were assessed using Computer-Assisted Sperm Analysis and flow cytometry, providing baseline values for future cryopreservation studies and biobanking applications. Overall, AVATIM illustrates how IMTA, reproductive biotechnology, and genetic resource conservation may jointly support sustainable Mediterranean Sea urchin management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦地中海可食海胆Paracentrotus lividus，针对野生种群因过度捕捞、气候变化等衰退问题，提出建立精子生物库的整合策略。综述结合AVATIM项目案例，评估了IMTA养殖模式、精子质量分析（CASA与流式细胞术）及冷冻保存在遗传资源保护与选择性育种中的应用潜力。来自南亚得里亚海的成熟雄性基线精子参数为后续cryopreservation研究提供了参考。研究表明，IMTA与生殖生物技术的协同可促进该物种的可持续水产养殖与资源管理。

papers.title: Microbial Pathogens, Disease Control and Veterinary Drug Use in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Wang, Yali; Cao, Haipeng
papers.abstract: The rapid intensification of global aquaculture, particularly the widespread application of recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), has substantially improved aquatic product yield [...]
papers.summary_cn: 全球水产养殖的快速集约化，尤其是循环水养殖系统（RAS）的广泛应用，显著提升了水产品产量。本文综述了水产养殖中微生物病原体的类型及其致病机制，并探讨了疾病防控策略与兽药使用现状。研究重点分析了RAS环境下病原体传播风险及抗生素耐药性问题，强调了综合病害管理的重要性。结论指出，优化兽药使用规范与生物安全措施是保障养殖可持续发展的关键。

papers.title: Evaluation of China’s marine ecological environment protection policies: a quantitative analysis of policy texts based on PMC indices
papers.authors: Shao, Yingyihao; Liu, Lu; Sun, Xuehang; Deng, Zhao
papers.abstract: Marine ecological environmental protection constitutes a core component of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, and it plays a pivotal role in advancing the development of a global marine community with a shared future.This study adopts the PMC index model to systematically analyze the evolutionary characteristics of 30 marine ecological environmental protection policies issued by the Chinese government between 2015 and 2024, aiming to offering valuable insights for national marine ecological environment protection efforts. The study shows that: (1) The mean value of the PMC index of China’s marine ecological environment protection policies reaches 6.243, which achieve outstanding performance in goal consistency, resource allocation, implementation efficiency and social impact. (2) China’s marine ecological environment protection policies are relatively excellent in areas such as policy evaluation, policy focus, policy instruments, policy characteristics, policy functions and policy areas, but they exhibit weaknesses in policy scope, policy timeliness and issuing institutions. (3) There are significant differences in the effectiveness of policy implementation. The case of Fujian Province further highlights the critical role of policy text design in marine ecological environment governance.This study provides actionable theoretical references for advancing the delivery of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and facilitating global marine ecological governance worldwide.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用PMC指数模型，系统分析了2015—2024年间中国政府发布的30项海洋生态环境保护政策文本，以评估其演化特征与实施效果。结果显示，政策PMC指数均值为6.243，在目标一致性、资源配置、执行效率和社会影响方面表现突出，但政策范围、时效性及发布机构维度存在短板。福建省案例进一步揭示了政策文本设计对治理成效的关键作用。研究为优化中国及全球海洋生态治理提供了理论参考。

papers.title: Connectivity and phylogenetic diversity of a fish metacommunity in subtropical coastal lakes
papers.authors: e Silva, Otávio Gutierrez; Fontana, Rodrigo Barbosa; Guimarães, Taís de Fátima Ramos; Becker, Fernando Gertum; Hartz, Sandra Maria
papers.abstract: Abstract Neotropical freshwater biodiversity is remarkable, mainly due to historical, biotic, and environmental processes. Landscape connectivity can promote or restrict species dispersal in fish metacommunities, thereby influencing the diversity and phylogenetic structure of communities. This study evaluated whether structural landscape variables of the Tramandaí River basin affect the phylogenetic diversity of the component communities of a fish metacommunity. The variables considered were primary and estuarine connection, lake shape and area, and distance from the sea. Phylogenetic diversity was estimated using a time-calibrated fish phylogeny and multiple phylogenetic diversity metrics, while the relationships between landscape variables and each metric were assessed using path analysis. The distribution of phylogenetic lineages across lakes was examined using Principal Coordinates of Phylogenetic Structure. The results revealed a negative effect of primary connection on the Nearest Relative Index and a negative effect of distance from the sea on the Nearest Taxon Index, as well as phylogenetic structuring associated with more isolated lakes and greater saline influence. The results highlight the importance of connectivity and distance from the sea in shaping the phylogenetic organization of fish metacommunities in the Tramandaí River basin, contributing to a better understanding of the processes that structure diversity in Neotropical coastal systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以巴西南部Tramandaí河流域亚热带沿海湖泊鱼类meta群落为对象，探讨景观连通性（初级与河口连接、湖泊形态与面积、距海距离）对系统发育多样性的影响。基于时间校准的鱼类系统发育树，采用多种系统发育多样性指标和路径分析，发现初级连接对最近亲缘指数有负效应，距海距离对最近分类单元指数有负效应，且系统发育结构在更隔离湖泊和盐度影响较大区域显著。结果表明连通性和距海距离是塑造该流域鱼类meta群落系统发育格局的关键因素，为理解新热带沿海系统多样性维持机制提供了新见解。

papers.title: Fish Farm Escapes Dataset
papers.authors: Jerez-Tallón, Mario; Beviá-Ballesteros, Ismael; Garcia-D’Urso, Nahuel; Toledo-Guedes, Kilian; Fernández-del-Campo, Jaime; Pitarch-Font, David; Azorín-López, Jorge; Fuster-Guilló, Andrés

papers.title: Insights into the sex life of an endemic riverine fish from F iji: P rotandrous hermaphroditism in the orange‐spotted therapon— Mesopristes kneri ( B leeker, 1876)
papers.authors: Copeland, Lekima K. F.; Hill‐Lewenilovo, Renee; Samson, Kimberly E. K.; Lal, Monal M.; Stockwell, Brian L.
papers.abstract: Abstract The orange‐spotted therapon, Mesopristes kneri , is an ecologically and economically important riverine fish endemic to Fiji, yet its life history and reproductive biology remain poorly understood. This study examined the reproductive biology, life history and sexual development of M. kneri to support conservation and fisheries management. From April 2022 to May 2023, field‐based histological analyses were conducted on 118 individuals sampled from the Navua River, comprising 86 females, 24 males, five transitional individuals and three sexually undifferentiated individuals. The findings support protandrous hermaphroditism, potentially through a monogynic pathway, as indicated by the absence of functional females in smaller size classes, size‐specific sex ratios and histological evidence of transitional gonads. Sexual dimorphism was evident, with females attaining larger body sizes than males. The length predicted to comprise 50% mature individuals was estimated at 20.39 cm SL, while the fitted transition model estimated X50, the length predicted to comprise 50% males, at 20.14 cm SL. Histological analyses confirmed asynchronous oocyte development and the presence of transitional gonads containing regressing testicular tissue and developing ovarian structures. The transitional gonads of M. kneri exhibited a delimited configuration, with a connective tissue barrier separating testicular and ovarian regions. The sampled population also showed a strongly female‐biased sex ratio, particularly in larger size classes, and a positive relationship between batch fecundity and female size. These findings indicate that management strategies should consider the protection of larger, highly fecund females while also maintaining sufficient smaller and intermediate‐sized functional males to support reproductive success. This study provides critical baseline information on the reproductive biology of M. kneri and contributes to the development of conservation and fisheries management strategies for Fiji's riverine ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 斐济特有河川鱼类橙色斑点鲈（Mesopristes kneri）的繁殖生物学研究显示其为雄性先熟雌雄同体，可能通过单雌通路发育。基于2022年4月至2023年5月从Navua河采集的118个样本的组织学分析，发现小型个体中无功能性雌鱼、性别比例随体长变化及过渡性性腺证据。雌鱼体型大于雄鱼，50%性成熟体长为20.39 cm SL，50%雄性转换体长为20.14 cm SL。过渡性性腺中睾丸组织退化与卵巢结构并存，由结缔组织屏障分隔，且种群性别比例偏雌，批次繁殖力与雌鱼体长正相关。管理策略应保护大型高繁殖力雌鱼，同时维持足够的小型至中型功能性雄鱼以保障繁殖成功。

papers.title: A decision-tree framework for the sustainable management of emerging fisheries and fishing innovations
papers.authors: Falsone, Fabio; Calabrò, Monica; Gancitano, Vita; Garofalo, Germana; Geraci, Michele Luca; Gjoni, Vojsava; Lauria, Valentina; Sardo, Giacomo; Scannella, Danilo; Vitale, Sergio
papers.abstract: Introduction Technological innovation in fisheries can rapidly alter exploitation patterns, often outpacing the capacity of regulatory systems to respond and increasing the risk of stock depletion or collapse. To address this challenge, this study presents a Decision-Tree Framework (DTF) designed to support precautionary and adaptive management when new fishing gears or substantial changes in fishing practices emerge. Methods The DTF combines an automated landing-based screening pathway, applied when at least six consecutive annual observations are available, with a structured expert-supported pathway for shorter time series or cases in which technological innovation is already recognised. The framework is implemented in R and as an interactive Shiny application. The performance of the automated landing-based screening component was evaluated through simulations representing abrupt and gradual increases in landings under alternative time-series lengths, effect magnitudes, observation noise levels and temporal autocorrelation conditions. The framework was applied to two contrasting Mediterranean case studies: the silver scabbardfish ( Lepidopus caudatus ) multi-gear fishery and the Mediterranean swordfish ( Xiphias gladius ) trap-line fishery. Results Simulation and case-study results show that the DTF can provide early warning signals of potentially unsustainable exploitation and offer transparent guidance for precautionary management actions, even where conventional stock assessments are limited or unavailable. Retrospective application to the scabbardfish fishery indicates that the DTF would have identified an early diagnostic signal and supported the consideration of precautionary management measures, while application to the swordfish fishery demonstrates consistency with precautionary policy decisions adopted under data-limited conditions. Discussion Overall, the DTF represents a proactive decision-support tool that operationalizes precautionary and adaptive management principles, enhances transparency in decision-making, and has the potential to support the management of emerging fisheries across diverse contexts, subject to further validation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种决策树框架（DTF），用于新兴渔业及捕捞技术创新出现时的预防性和适应性管理。该框架结合基于登陆数据的自动筛选路径（适用于至少六年连续观测）与专家支持路径（针对短时间序列或已识别创新案例），并通过模拟及地中海银带鲱（Lepidopus caudatus）多网具渔业和剑鱼（Xiphias gladius）陷阱线渔业案例验证。结果表明，DTF能在常规stock assessment受限时提供早期不可持续开发预警，并支持预防性管理决策，增强决策透明度，具有跨情境应用潜力。

papers.title: Science-to-policy transition in fisheries genetics theses in Türkiye: Patterns and gaps (1995–2024)
papers.authors: Göncüoğlu Bodur, Huriye; Günay, Deniz
papers.abstract: This study analysed 66 postgraduate theses in fisheries genetics completed in Türkiye between 1995 and 2024, aiming to examine the gap in the transition of scientific knowledge into fisheries management policies. Data obtained from the National Thesis Centre of YÖK (Council of Higher Education) were evaluated using Poisson and logistic regression, Multiple Correspondence Analysis (MCA) and K-means analysis. The results indicate that academic output is dominated by master’s thesis (68.2%), and majority of research geographically concentrated in Marmara (69.7%) and Black Sea (65.2%) regions. The taxonomic focus was found to centre largely on fish species (77.8%). Methodologically, 74.2% of the studies are based on the traditional mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) markers. The most remarkable result is the absence of a direct management focus in 78.8% of the theses, which has shown no statistically significant improvement over three decades (p = 0.868). However, doctoral dissertations were more likely to include a management focus than master’s theses (p = 0.022), suggesting that advanced graduate research may contribute more directly to management-oriented knowledge production. MCA and clustering analyses revealed that applied stock genetics and theoretical ecological genetics operate in isolated thematic clusters, pointing to an epistemological barrier. The present study underscores the existence of a structural gap in the science-policy transition in studies conducted in the field of fisheries genetics in Türkiye and highlights the need for establishing a robust interface between universities and public decision-makers in order to transform genetic data into a strategic regulatory instrument.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了土耳其1995–2024年间66篇渔业遗传学研究生论文，旨在探讨科学知识向渔业管理政策转化的缺口。结果显示，学术产出以硕士论文为主（68.2%），研究地理上集中于马尔马拉海（69.7%）和黑海（65.2%）区域，分类学重点以鱼类为主（77.8%），方法上74.2%依赖传统线粒体DNA（mtDNA）标记。最显著发现是78.8%的论文缺乏直接管理导向，且三十年间无统计显著改善（p = 0.868）；但博士论文比硕士论文更可能包含管理焦点（p = 0.022）。MCA和聚类分析揭示应用性stock genetics与理论生态遗传学处于孤立主题簇，表明存在认识论障碍。研究强调土耳其渔业遗传学领域存在科学-政策转化的结构性缺口，需建立大学与公共决策者间的坚实接口，以将遗传数据转化为战略监管工具。

papers.title: A biological carbon pump code of practice for high seas fisheries
papers.authors: Cavan, Emma L.; Martin, Angela H.; Reid, David G.; Visser, André W.; Pinti, Jérôme; Mariani, Gaël; Rastrick, Samuel P. S.; Wright, Katherine; Harden-Davies, Harriet
papers.summary_cn: 针对公海渔业提出生物碳泵实践规范，旨在通过管理渔业活动减少对深海碳循环的干扰。该规范强调评估捕捞对碳输出通量的影响，并建议将碳储存纳入渔业管理决策，以支持气候减缓目标。

papers.title: Independent evidence that PFOS concentrations in surface water predict PFOS concentrations in fish across contrasting aquatic ecosystems
papers.authors: Karlsson, O Magnus; Mansanarez, Valentin; Hållén, Joakim; Jonsson, Arvid; Waldetoft, Hannes
papers.summary_cn: 该研究旨在验证地表水中PFOS浓度能否预测鱼类体内PFOS含量，并评估其在不同水生生态系统中的适用性。通过对比多个差异显著的水体环境，研究提供了独立证据，表明地表水PFOS浓度与鱼类PFOS累积之间存在一致的正相关关系。这一发现支持将地表水监测作为鱼类污染风险评估的简化替代指标，对渔业资源管理和水产品质量安全预警具有参考价值。

papers.title: Immunofluorescence Assay to Detect PM<sub>2.5</sub>-Mediated DNA Damage in Fish Embryos
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在开发一种免疫荧光检测方法，用于评估PM2.5暴露对鱼类胚胎DNA损伤的影响。通过该方法可定量分析细颗粒物诱导的遗传毒性，为水环境健康监测提供敏感工具。研究面向渔业生态毒理学领域，重点关注PM2.5污染的生物早期预警指标。

papers.title: Mud crab (Genus Scylla) aquaculture: integrating biological knowledge and technological advances toward sustainability
papers.authors: Murak; Ahmad, Muhammad Sajjad; Fazhan, Hanafiah; Lan, Kuo-Wei; Waiho, Khor; Ma, Hongyu; Ikhwanuddin, Mhd
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了泥蟹（Scylla属）养殖领域的研究进展，旨在整合生物学知识与技术革新以推动产业可持续发展。文章系统梳理了泥蟹的生物学特性、养殖技术瓶颈及生态影响，并探讨了循环水养殖、饲料优化和疾病防控等先进技术的应用潜力。通过多学科交叉分析，提出了提升养殖效率与环境友好性的综合策略，为泥蟹养殖业的绿色转型提供科学依据。

papers.title: Exploring the significance of Kenya's indigenous and emerging blue foods for sustainable aquaculture development. A review
papers.authors: Munguti, Jonathan; Muthoka, Mavindu; Kyule, Domitila; Magondu, Esther; Obiero, Kevin; Mboya, Jimmy; Meenakshisundaram, Menaga; Chrysantus, Tanga M.; Kwikiriza, Gerald; Njonge, Francis K.
papers.journal: Journal of the World Aquaculture Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Kenya's aquaculture sector is at a pivotal stage, transitioning from a historical reliance on Nile tilapia and African catfish toward a more diversified production portfolio that integrates indigenous and emerging freshwater and marine species. This shift is increasingly recognized as essential to enhance climate resilience, food security, and ecosystem health. This systematic review synthesizes more than two decades (2000 to 31st January, 2026) of peer‐reviewed literature to evaluate the biological suitability, culture performance, and socio‐ecological roles of underutilized native taxa, including Ningu ( Labeo victorianus) , Jipe tilapia ( Oreochromis jipe) , freshwater prawns ( Macrobrachium spp.), rabbitfish ( Siganus sutor ), marine‐acclimatized Nile tilapia, mud crab ( Scylla serrata ), sea cucumber ( Holothuria scabra ), oysters ( Crassostrea cucullata ), and seaweeds ( Eucheuma, Kappaphycus , and Ulva spp.). Literature indexed in Scopus, ScienceDirect, and Wiley Online Library was thematically synthesized across four domains: species biology and fishery status; culture systems and trials; constraints to domestication and commercialization; and potential roles within diversified culture systems. The findings indicate strong ecological adaptability and market potential among several indigenous species; however, their domestication and commercialization remain constrained by unreliable seed supply, underdeveloped hatchery and feed systems, limited access to capital and technical capacity, and weak processing, certification, market, and distribution networks. Culture trials demonstrate the viability of low‐input and integrated multi‐trophic aquaculture (IMTA) systems that link finfish, crustaceans, bivalves, and seaweeds to nutrient recycling and habitat restoration. Economically, low‐input species such as seaweeds, oysters, milkfish, and rabbitfish offer opportunities to reduce dependence on formulated feeds and diversify household incomes, while mud crab, sea cucumber, and Macrobrachium prawns provide higher‐value coastal and export‐oriented opportunities but require greater investment before scale‐up. Accordingly, the proposed phased roadmap prioritizes marine‐acclimatized O. niloticus , the Lake Baringo strain of O. niloticus , seaweeds, oysters, milkfish, and rabbitfish for near‐term farmer and enterprise development, mud crab, sea cucumber, and indigenous Macrobrachium prawns for medium‐term high‐value development, and O. jipe and L. victorianus primarily for conservation‐oriented aquaculture. Coordinated investment in hatchery development, seed quality, selective breeding, market assessment, feed innovation, and value‐chain integration is therefore needed to translate these opportunities into commercially viable, climate‐resilient blue‐food systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统评估了肯尼亚本土及新兴蓝色食物（如Ningu、Jipe罗非鱼、淡水虾、篮子鱼、泥蟹、海参、牡蛎及海藻等）在水产养殖中的生物学适宜性、养殖表现及社会生态作用，基于2000至2026年间文献进行主题综合分析。结果显示多数本土物种具有较强生态适应性和市场潜力，但受种苗供应、孵化及饲料体系不完善、资金与技术能力不足及产业链薄弱等制约。低投入物种（如海藻、牡蛎、遮目鱼）可减少饲料依赖并多样化收入，而高价值物种（如泥蟹、海参）需更大投资。据此提出分阶段发展路线，优先推广耐盐罗非鱼、海藻等近中期品种，并强调孵化、选育、市场及价值链整合的协同投资，以推动气候韧性蓝色食品体系商业化。

papers.title: Precision Microbiome Engineering as a Dual Strategy for Aquaculture Wastewater Bioremediation and Antimicrobial Resistance Mitigation: A Narrative Review
papers.authors: Dwivedi, Aishwarya; Sharma, Jai Gopal
papers.journal: Journal of Pure and Applied Microbiology
papers.abstract: Over 50% of aquatic food production depends on aquaculture, which faces sustainability challenges, including wastewater pollution, eutrophication from excess nitrogen and phosphorus, and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) from effluent discharge. Conventional wastewater treatment can’t fully address these problems, increasing environmental and health risks. The concept of precision microbiome engineering (PME), which includes next-generation probiotics, synthetic microbial communities (SynComs), and omics-guided bioremediation consortia, is seen as revolutionary because it can enhance bioremediation and prevent antimicrobial resistance (AMR). However, PME’s application to host-associated and environmental microbiomes is less studied. This review proposes a strategy linking host microbiome manipulation to wastewater bioremediation to address AMR. It combines environmental biotechnology and aquaculture science to evaluate the role of PME across these interconnected domains critically. It provides a comprehensive overview of the microbial ecology of host systems in aquaculture and their corresponding effluents. The text analyzes how probiotics, postbiotics, and synbiotics boost fish immunity and combat resistant pathogens. It also assesses advanced bioremediation methods like biofloc, MBBRs, and microbial consortia. This review redefines PME as an integrated system rather than isolated interventions, considering current knowledge on aquaculture wastewater, AMR mechanisms, and treatment limitations. It critically assesses ecological, regulatory, biosafety, and scalability issues, highlighting knowledge gaps and dangers. The article proposes a model combining SynCom construction using multi-omics, CRISPR, and real-time microbiome monitoring via AI.
papers.summary_cn: 全球超50%水产食品依赖养殖业，但面临废水污染、氮磷富营养化及抗生素耐药性（AMR）等挑战。本文提出精准微生物组工程（PME）作为双重策略，通过整合宿主微生物调控与废水生物修复，系统评估益生菌、后生元及生物絮团等技术的抗耐药与净化效能。综述强调PME应从孤立干预转向集成系统，并构建结合多组学、CRISPR与AI实时监测的SynCom模型，同时指出生态、监管及规模化瓶颈。

papers.title: Smart IoT-Based Aquaculture Water Quality Assessment System using Machine Learning
papers.authors: Siva Rama Krishna, K.; Yarrarapu, Manasa; Bhavani, Alanka Durga; Merugumalli, Rama Krishna; Kumar, G. Vijaya; Rao, K. Srinivasa
papers.journal: Journal of The Institution of Engineers (India): Series B

papers.title: Natural reproductive modulators in aquaculture: endocrine mechanisms, microalgal and plant-derived bioactives, and sustainability perspectives
papers.authors: Cortes, Jaynos R.; Penionez, John Lloyd F.; Paragua, Ciara Mie V.; Respecia, Christian C.; Ulit, Gino G.; Mayakie, Zyril A.
papers.abstract: Synthetic hormonal induction is an established tool in modern aquaculture for overcoming reproductive dysfunction, synchronizing spawning, inducing final gamete maturation, and supporting reliable seed production. Growing interest in complementary reproductive strategies has stimulated research on natural bioactive compounds that may support reproduction through endocrine, nutritional, metabolic, and antioxidant pathways. This review critically evaluates microalgal and plant-derived reproductive bioactives in relation to conventional hormonal induction, with particular emphasis on the strength and directness of mechanistic evidence. Microalgal compounds evaluated include long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids (LC-PUFAs), carotenoids, sterols, and antioxidant polysaccharides, whereas plant-derived compounds include phytoestrogens, flavonoids, saponins, alkaloids, and terpenoids. Available studies associate selected interventions with measurable reproductive endpoints, including gonadal development, fecundity, gamete quality, fertilization, hatchability, spawning performance, and offspring survival. As one study-specific example, pituitary extract treatment in African catfish produced 89.23% fertilization, 93.31% hatchability, 87.16% survival, and 69.41% fry production; however, such values cannot be generalized across interventions because reproductive studies differ substantially in species, compounds, doses, treatment duration, reproductive stage, and outcome definitions. Microalgal LC-PUFAs and carotenoids are supported primarily by evidence of nutritional, membrane-associated, metabolic, and antioxidant reproductive support, whereas direct endocrine effects remain less consistently demonstrated. Plant-derived bioactives show greater mechanistic heterogeneity, with responses frequently dependent on compound identity, dose, species, sex, and reproductive stage. Current evidence therefore supports natural bioactives mainly as complementary tools for broodstock conditioning, gamete support, and reproductive management rather than universal substitutes for conventional hormonal induction. Major limitations include heterogeneous protocols, inadequate dose standardization, species-specific responses, limited direct endocrine validation, insufficient long-term safety assessment, commercialization constraints, and regulatory uncertainty. Future research should prioritize standardized dose-response experiments, direct hormonal and molecular measurements, chemically characterized preparations, long-term and multigenerational safety assessment, and commercially relevant hatchery trials. Overall, natural reproductive bioactives have considerable potential within integrated reproductive-management strategies, but their practical application should be guided by mechanistic evidence, species-specific validation, and clearly defined reproductive objectives.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述评估了微藻和植物源天然生物活性物质在水产养殖繁殖调控中的作用机制，并与传统激素诱导进行比较。微藻来源的LC-PUFAs和类胡萝卜素主要通过营养、代谢及抗氧化途径支持繁殖，而植物源化合物（如植物雌激素、类黄酮）的效应则高度依赖种类、剂量和生殖阶段。现有证据支持这些天然产物作为亲鱼营养强化和配子辅助管理的补充工具，而非激素诱导的替代方案。未来需加强剂量标准化、内分泌机制验证及多世代安全性评估。

papers.title: Organically enriched water from an integrated agri-aquaculture system enhances antioxidant defense and secondary metabolism in blackberry (Rubus ulmifolius cv. Tupy)
papers.authors: Flores-Aguilar, Priscila Sarai; Carbajal-Valenzuela, Ireri A.; Olvera-Olvera, Carlos; Soto-Zarazúa, Genaro Martín; Chandrakasan, Gobinath; Rivas-Araiza, Edgar; Gonzalez-Cordoba, Jose L.
papers.abstract: Introduction Integrated agri-aquaculture systems can improve water-use efficiency and nutrient recycling in semiarid and arid regions increasingly affected by climate change; however, the physiological responses of fruit crops to aquaculture-derived irrigation water remain poorly understood. This study evaluated the growth, photosynthetic status, and biochemical responses of blackberry ( Rubus ulmifolius cv. Tupy) irrigated with organically enriched water from an integrated tilapia–blackberry system operated under geodesic-dome conditions in semidesert central Mexico. Methods Four irrigation treatments were compared: a conventional nutrient solution, unsupplemented tilapia-culture effluent, tilapia-culture effluent supplemented with mineral nutrients, and well water adjusted to the same pH as the fertilized treatments. Plant growth traits, leaf greenness, normalized difference vegetation index, antioxidant enzyme activities, total phenolic compounds, and flavonoids were monitored for 216 h after irrigation began. Results and discussion Plants irrigated with supplemented tilapia-culture effluent maintained growth and canopy greenness comparable to those receiving the conventional nutrient solution. In contrast, unsupplemented tilapia-culture effluent and well water induced stronger antioxidant and secondary-metabolic responses, particularly in superoxide dismutase and catalase activities and in the temporal dynamics of phenolic compounds and flavonoids, whereas phenylalanine ammonia-lyase showed a weaker and later response. These patterns suggest that mineral-supplemented effluent primarily supported vegetative performance, whereas unsupplemented effluent was associated with a nutritional elicitation response potentially related to relative nutrient limitation and biologically active components in the effluent. During the 216-h evaluation period, unsupplemented effluent maintained plant performance comparable to that under the fertilized treatments, suggesting that aquaculture-derived water may reduce mineral-fertilizer inputs during specific crop stages. Because the experiment was short-term, no conclusions can be drawn regarding long-term productivity, fruit quality, or sustained plant responses. Overall, the findings support the potential of integrated agri-aquaculture systems as a water-smart approach for blackberry cultivation in water-limited semidesert environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了综合农业-水产养殖系统中富有机质水对黑莓（Rubus ulmifolius cv. Tupy）生长、光合及生化响应的影响，旨在评估其在半干旱地区替代传统营养液的可行性。通过对比常规营养液、未补充罗非鱼养殖废水、补充矿质营养的养殖废水及调pH井水四种灌溉处理，监测216小时内植株生长、抗氧化酶活性及次生代谢物动态。结果显示，补充矿质营养的养殖废水维持了与常规营养液相当的生长和冠层绿度，而未补充废水则诱导更强的抗氧化防御（如SOD和CAT活性升高）及酚类、类黄酮波动，但未显著抑制植株表现。研究表明，养殖废水可在特定生长阶段减少矿质肥料投入，支持综合系统作为水资源受限地区黑莓种植的节水策略，但长期产量和品质影响需进一步验证。

papers.title: Fine-scale extraction of floating raft and cage aquaculture based on directional anisotropic feature enhancement
papers.authors: Huang, Kaihua; Liu, Bingxin; Liu, Baozhan; Zhu, Xueyuan; Liu, Peng; Li, Ying
papers.summary_cn: 基于方向性各向异性特征增强技术，实现浮筏与网箱养殖的精细尺度提取。该方法利用遥感影像中的方向纹理差异，提升养殖设施识别精度，适用于渔业资源空间监测与管理。

papers.title: Functional application of monkey jack (Artocarpus lacucha) pulp extract as a natural preservative: Effects on quality, safety, and storage stability of raw pangasius fish balls
papers.authors: Rabby, Md. Golam; Hossain, Md. Nayim; Keya, Maymuna Islam; Zahid, Md. Ashrafuzzaman; Parvin, Rashida; Syduzzaman, Md
papers.abstract: This study evaluated how Monkey jack pulp extract (MJPE) impacted the raw Pangasius ( Pangasianodon hypophthalmus ) fish balls physicochemical quality, microbiological safety, oxidative, and storage stability while being refrigerated. Fish balls were made with several antioxidants, including control (T0), butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT, T1), ascorbic acid (AA, T2), and MJPE at increasing concentrations (T3 and T4), and kept for 10 days at 4°C. On days 1, 5, and 10, changes in pH, cooking loss, color characteristics ( L* , a* , b* , chroma, and hue angle), heme iron content, antioxidant activity (DPPH), lipid oxidation (TBARS), and total viable count (TVC) were assessed. All samples showed quality decrease with increasing storage time. However, antioxidants treated samples showed significantly ( P < 0.05) higher stability than the control treated samples in every storage day. T4 successfully inhibited pH rise, decreased cooking loss, maintained higher heme iron levels, and preserved color characteristics rather than other treatments. Additionally, T4 showed higher DPPH scavenging capacity (ranged 72.44% to 65.79%), whereas the control showed the lower DPPH value (ranged 56.57% to 33.39%). TBARS value showed the lowest (0.31 to 0.41 mg MDA/kg sample) in T4 and the highest (0.49 to 0.67 mg MDA/kg sample) in the control. MJPE considerably reduced bacterial growth (0.80 to1.68 Log10 CFU/mL) compared to control and synthetic antioxidants treated samples. In terms of keeping the quality and enhancing the shelf life, MJPE demonstrated significantly improved antioxidant and antimicrobial effects compared to BHT and AA ( P < 0.05). MJPE showed significant potential as a natural preservative for fish-based products by improving their physicochemical, microbiological, and oxidative stability during refrigerated storage.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了猴面包果（Artocarpus lacucha）果肉提取物（MJPE）作为天然保鲜剂对冷藏生鲶鱼（Pangasianodon hypophthalmus）鱼丸品质、安全性及贮藏稳定性的影响。鱼丸分别添加对照（T0）、BHT（T1）、抗坏血酸（T2）及递增浓度MJPE（T3、T4），于4°C贮藏10天，定期检测pH、蒸煮损失、色泽、血红素铁、DPPH抗氧化活性、TBARS脂质氧化及总菌落数。结果显示，所有样品品质随时间下降，但MJPE处理（尤其T4）显著抑制pH升高、降低蒸煮损失、维持血红素铁和色泽，并表现出最高DPPH清除率（65.79%-72.44%）和最低TBARS值（0.31-0.41 mg MDA/kg），同时将细菌生长抑制在0.80-1.68 Log10 CFU/mL，效果优于BHT和抗坏血酸。MJPE在冷藏期间显著提升鱼丸的理化、微生物及氧化稳定性，具备作为鱼类制品天然保鲜剂的潜力。

papers.title: Repeated competition influences neural response, but not neurogenesis or physiology, in the fighting fish Betta splendens
papers.authors: Spool, Jeremy A.; Heywood, Alexander J. A.; Berganross, Ruth E. W.; Aquino, Elaine A.; Bambe, Temidayo D.; Wallace, Kelly J.
papers.abstract: Territorial competition has costs such as wounds received, energy spent, and elevated chronic stress. How does Betta splendens, a species that has been artificially selected for enhanced territorial aggression, maintain high levels of metabolically costly displays (gill flaring) over repeated days of territorial competition? Here we conducted two experiments. The first exposed male Betta splendens to a size-matched unresolvable competition (a mirror) daily for three weeks. We found that Betta splendens indeed maintain gill flaring throughout the competition schedule and exhibited no baseline stress impacts (measured via a scototaxis assay). We then exposed Betta splendens to one, two, or three weeks of competition and quantified cortisol levels, neurogenesis, and neural response in brain regions associated with social processing. We again found that Betta splendens showed consistently elevated gill flaring and again found no impacts on stress (measured via waterborne cortisol). Competition-exposed fish displayed increased neural response in the caudal supracommissural nucleus of the ventral telencephalon (Vs), a region that is homologous to the medial amygdala/bed nucleus of the stria terminalis and a central mediator of social decision-making. Neural response in this same region positively correlated with individual variation in gill flaring. Competition did not influence neurogenesis (doublecortin expression). Lastly, a measure of reproductive investment (gonadosomatic index) did not correlate to behavior but did correlate to cortisol levels, suggesting a cohesive physiological state related to reproduction in this species. Taken together, this work details the mechanisms that are relevant to the maintenance of costly aggressive behavior.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以人工选育高攻击性的泰国斗鱼（Betta splendens）为对象，探讨其在连续三周不可解竞争（镜面刺激）中维持高成本展示行为（鳃盖展开）的机制。实验结合行为学、皮质醇测定、神经发生（doublecortin表达）及脑区神经反应分析，发现斗鱼在整个竞争期间持续表现鳃盖展开，且无基线应激或水环境皮质醇水平升高。竞争暴露显著增强腹侧端脑尾侧连合上核（Vs，与内侧杏仁核/终纹床核同源）的神经反应，且该反应与个体鳃盖展开变异正相关，但未影响神经发生或生殖投入（性腺指数）。结果表明，维持攻击行为主要依赖社会决策脑区的可塑性调节，而非慢性应激或神经发生改变。

papers.title: Navigating morphometric minefields: Modelling heteroscedasticity in length‐conversion models
papers.authors: Burton, Alex J. C.; Braccini, J. Matías; Smith, Adam N. H.
papers.abstract: Abstract A common problem when combining data on species' traits from multiple sources is that researchers often measure the same trait in different ways. For example, the length of a shark can be measured in a straight‐line or over‐the‐body, and for lengths that include the tail (e.g., fork and total lengths), with the tail in ‘stretched’ or ‘natural’ position. Statistical models comparing one variant to another can be used to standardise length measurements, thus allowing data to be combined. Often, when fitting such models, little attention is paid to the patterns of residuals, trusting that log‐transforming the data adequately accounts for heteroscedasticity, or whether conversion models built with data from defrosted specimens can be used on data from fresh (or live) individuals. Using a Bayesian modelling approach, we compared the out‐of‐sample predictive performance of linear and log‐linear models, with and without a model term that explicitly modelled heteroscedasticity as a function of the predictor variable, for converting between several length variants for school shark ( Galeorhinus galeus ). We found that point predictions were effectively identical across all four model forms. However, models including a term for heteroscedasticity produced superior predictive performance and prediction interval coverage. Measurements recorded from fresh individuals also fell within the prediction intervals of values estimated by models built using length variants measured from defrosted animals, suggesting that such models can be used to convert between length variants measured from fresh animals. Although the simpler models may be adequate for producing point estimates of the mean, models used to convert between length variants should include a term that explicitly models heteroscedasticity wherever prediction intervals or propagated uncertainty matter.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对多源数据整合中鱼类长度测量方式不一致的问题，以school shark（Galeorhinus galeus）为对象，采用贝叶斯方法比较线性与对数线性模型，并引入显式建模异方差性的项，评估不同长度转换模型的预测性能。结果显示，各模型点预测几乎一致，但含异方差项的模型在预测区间覆盖率和预测性能上更优；基于解冻标本构建的模型可有效转换新鲜个体数据。建议在需要预测区间或不确定性传播时，长度转换模型应包含异方差项，尽管简单模型对均值估计足够。

papers.authors: Hinterman, Kevin D.; Hoehn, Matthew R.; Gardner, Luke D.; Hamilton, Scott L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate estimates of age, growth and maturation are fundamental to fisheries assessment, conservation and the development of emerging aquaculture species. However, life‐history parameters can vary within species and may be influenced by factors such as sexual dimorphism, which is often poorly quantified in non‐commercial or understudied species. The monkeyface prickleback ( Cebidichthys violaceus ), one of the largest herbivorous fish along the west coast of North America and a potential aquaculture candidate, remains relatively understudied with respect to life‐history variation and sexual dimorphism. This study updates and expands previously reported life‐history parameters of C. violaceus by incorporating a wider size range of individuals, including juveniles, and evaluates sexual dimorphism in cranial morphology using geometric morphometric methods. Von Bertalanffy growth functions based on otolith sectioning and updated length‐weight relationships were developed for adult males, females and all fish combined. Length and age at maturation were estimated to be earlier than previously reported, with most individuals maturing before 28.2 cm in length and 5 years of age. Females were generally heavier than males of the same length, whereas males were longer than females of the same age and attained greater maximum lengths. Condition factor only differed between adult males and juveniles. Sexual dimorphism was assessed using body metrics and quantified through geometric morphometric analyses of head and supraorbital crest shape. Head shape, supraorbital crest shape and eye size differed significantly between sexes, with morphological differences becoming more pronounced with increasing body size, providing clear evidence of sexual dimorphism in adult C. violaceus . These findings will aid in the sustainable management of wild populations and optimise broodstock selection and aquaculture development for the species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究更新了猴脸鳚（Cebidichthys violaceus）的生活史参数，通过耳石切片和体长-体重关系建立von Bertalanffy生长方程，并利用几何形态测量学评估头骨和眶上嵴的性别二态性。结果显示，性成熟体长和年龄早于以往报道（多数个体在28.2 cm和5龄前成熟），雌鱼同体长下更重，雄鱼同年龄下更长且最大体长更大；头形、眶上嵴和眼径在成体间显著差异，且随体型增大而加剧。研究为野生种群可持续管理和该潜在 aquaculture 物种的亲本选择提供了关键依据。

papers.title: Decoupled drivers of diversity and composition in coastal forage fish communities reveal pathways for restoration effects in the Florida Everglades
papers.authors: Lesser, Justin Samuel; Schrandt, Meagan N.; Davis, John P.; James, W. Ryan; Rehage, Jennifer; Strickland, Bradley; Santos, Rolando
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦佛罗里达大沼泽地沿海饵料鱼群落，旨在解析多样性与物种组成解耦的驱动机制，并评估恢复措施（如淡水流量调节）的生态效应。通过分析环境因子与群落结构关系，发现水文连通性、盐度梯度等关键变量对多样性和组成产生差异化影响，表明恢复行动需针对特定群落维度设计。研究为沿海生态系统修复提供了基于饵料鱼群落的量化路径参考。

papers.title: Fish navigate a hydrodynamic maze via yaw-mediated lateral migration
papers.authors: Calicchia, Michael A.; Ni, Rui
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: In aquatic environments, gradients in flow velocity and turbulence define a constantly shifting landscape that sets the physical constraints on propulsion and energy expenditure in fish. Successfully navigating these complex flows depends on the ability to sense and respond to subtle hydrodynamic cues in an energy-efficient manner. Revealing these mechanisms is central to understanding how fish identify and exploit favorable flow conditions. To this end, we designed a hydrodynamic maze with spatially varying mean flow and turbulence, creating a controlled heterogeneous flow landscape for understanding fish movement strategies. We found that fish escape energetically unfavorable regions by yawing their bodies relative to the flow. These yawed orientations appear to facilitate lateral migration through lift forces and may improve sensitivity to local flow variations. Notably, fish maintain body orientations near, but below, predicted stall conditions to exploit lift without a significant increase in drag. These findings provide insight into how fish navigate heterogeneous hydrodynamic environments, with potential relevance for both natural and engineered flow systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过设计具有空间变化流速和湍流的水动力迷宫，探究鱼类在复杂流场中的运动策略。发现鱼类通过相对于水流偏航身体（yaw）实现侧向迁移，以逃离能量不利区域，并利用升力提高对局部流场变化的感知。鱼类将身体姿态维持在预测失速条件附近但低于该阈值，从而在不显著增加阻力的情况下获取升力优势。研究揭示了鱼类导航异质水动力环境的机制，对自然和工程流系统具有参考意义。

papers.title: Behavioural Diversity of Fishes: Concepts, Drivers and Its Role in Conservation and Management
papers.authors: Prchalová, Marie; Arlinghaus, Robert; Westrelin, Samuel; Jarić, Ivan; Bertram, Michael G.; Alós, Josep; Baktoft, Henrik; Brand, Jack A.; Brodin, Tomas; Cordero‐Rivera, Adolfo
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human activity has altered nearly all ecosystems on Earth, contributing to substantial biodiversity loss across taxonomic, genetic and functional dimensions, from the intraspecific to the ecosystem scale. Yet some components of biodiversity remain hidden or underappreciated, including behavioural diversity. Behaviour is often among the earliest whole‐organism responses to environmental change, and diversity in behaviour can occur within individuals, among individuals, among populations and across communities and ecosystems. This variation may influence growth, survival, reproduction, ecological interactions and responses to anthropogenic pressures, although its effects on population stability and resilience are likely context‐, scale‐ and component‐dependent. In this review, we examine behavioural diversity in fishes, defined here as variation in behavioural traits across levels of biological organisation, from individuals to ecosystems. Our review has two complementary aims. First, we provide a conceptual overview of behavioural diversity, clarify how it differs from related constructs such as personality, plasticity, and behavioural syndromes, and summarise the evolutionary, ontogenetic, ecological, stochastic and anthropogenic processes that generate or erode it. Second, we evaluate why behavioural diversity matters for fish ecology, fisheries management, aquaculture, restoration and conservation. We conclude by identifying key research needs, including improved quantification, stronger empirical links between behavioural diversity and ecological outcomes, and the development of management approaches sensitive to behavioural diversity. More explicit consideration of behavioural diversity should improve our ability to predict fish behavioural diversity responses and to design conservation and management measures that account for variation rather than only average behavioural responses.
papers.summary_cn: 人类活动已导致生物多样性在多维度丧失，但行为多样性作为重要组分常被忽视。本文综述了鱼类行为多样性的概念框架，将其定义为从个体到生态系统各生物组织水平上行为性状的变异，并厘清了其与个性、可塑性和行为综合征等概念的区别。文章系统总结了产生或削弱行为多样性的进化、个体发育、生态、随机及人为过程，并评估了行为多样性对鱼类生态、渔业管理、水产养殖、修复和保护的意义。研究指出，未来需改进量化方法、加强行为多样性与生态结果的实证联系，并发展对行为多样性敏感的管理策略，以超越仅基于平均行为反应的预测与保护设计。

papers.title: Metabarcoding of ichthyoplankton communities from the entrance of the Gulf of California (March, 2016)
papers.authors: Díaz‐Viloria, Noé; Geraldo‐Savín, Del Socorro Nadia Ludmila; Jiménez‐Rosenberg, Sylvia Patricia Adelheid; Munguía‐Vega, Adrián; Vázquez‐Juárez, Ricardo; Juárez, Óscar E.; Reguera‐Rouzaud, Nicole; Silva‐Segundo, Claudia Alicia; Sánchez‐Velasco, Laura; Godínez, Victor M.
papers.abstract: Abstract This study aimed to identify species of marine ichthyoplankton communities from the entrance of the Gulf of California, using morphological and DNA metabarcoding methods. Twenty‐eight zooplankton samples were collected by vertical trawls in the study area, from 2 to 8 March 2016. A total of 742 marine fish larvae and 333 fish eggs were separated and morphologically identified to the most precise taxonomic level or typified, respectively. Subsequently, larvae and eggs were pooled by sampling station for DNA extraction. A 12S amplicon library (167–185 bp) was constructed and sent for high‐throughput sequencing on an Illumina HiSeq (2X150 bp) platform. The Obitools bioinformatic pipeline was implemented for assembly and quality control of amplicon sequences. Ecotag and BLAST searches were performed for taxonomic assignment of amplicons (similarity ≥97%) when compared with 12S fish sequences from GenBank. Metabarcoding results showed a similar number of orders, families and genera to the morphological method. However, at the species level, the DNA metabarcoding method revealed 17 species that were not recognized by the morphological method, indicating that the DNA method was more precise and contributed to the knowledge of the species richness of fishes that spawn in the study area. Furthermore, our presence/absence results aligned largely with the more common ichthyoplankton species found in most oceanographic surveys in the region. A comparison with a previous study performed in the same oceanographic survey indicates concordance with the spatial distribution of Benthosema panamense , which was delimited by temperature. However, differences with the spatial distribution of Diaphus pacificus were observed, likely because this species was concealed within unidentified eggs. In conclusion, DNA metabarcoding is a valuable complement to traditional morphological identification in ichthyoplankton research and can contribute to finding some undetected members of ichthyoplankton communities as well as geographical differences in their species richness.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用形态学与DNA metabarcoding相结合的方法，鉴定加利福尼亚湾入口处海洋鱼卵和仔稚鱼群落物种组成。基于2016年3月2-8日垂直拖网采集的28份浮游动物样本，分离出742尾鱼仔鱼和333粒鱼卵，构建12S扩增子文库并进行Illumina HiSeq高通量测序。结果显示，DNA metabarcoding在目、科、属水平上与形态学鉴定结果相近，但在物种水平上额外检出17个形态学未识别物种，表明其精度更高。空间分布比较发现，Benthosema panamense的分布与温度相关，与前期研究一致，而Diaphus pacificus的分布差异可能源于其被隐藏于未鉴定鱼卵中。结论认为，DNA metabarcoding是传统形态学鉴定的有效补充，有助于揭示仔稚鱼群落中未被发现的物种及其地理分布差异。

papers.title: Analysis of Law Enforcement Against Violations of Fishing Permits (SIPI), Fishing Vessel Permits (SIKPI), and Fisheries Business Permits (SIUP) Reviewed from Law Number 45 of 2009
papers.authors: Suseno, Adi; Hutauruk, Appe; Maruba Parlindungan Hutahaean, Fendi; Sunarno, Sunarno
papers.journal: JIHAD : Jurnal Ilmu Hukum dan Administrasi
papers.abstract: The licensing provisions in fisheries business activities, namely the Fisheries Business License (SIUP), Fishing License (SIPI), and Fish Transport Vessel License (SIKPI), are state control instruments for the orderly and sustainable utilization of fish resources. Violations of the obligation to own these permits are not merely administrative in nature, but are categorized as criminal acts in the fisheries sector as regulated in Law Number 31 of 2004 concerning Fisheries as amended by Law Number 45 of 2009. This article aims to analyze the regulation of SIPI, SIKPI, and SIUP according to Law Number 45 of 2009 and their legal enforcement, by taking a case study of Decision Number 72/Pid.Sus-Prk/2024/PN.Rkb. This research uses a normative legal research method with a legislative approach, a case approach, and a conceptual approach. The research results show that the regulation of SIUP, SIPI, and SIKPI has a clear legal basis but has undergone adjustments to norms after the implementation of the risk-based licensing policy through the Online Single Submission system, without eliminating the criminal nature of violations for large-scale business actors. Law enforcement in the field is still hampered by overlapping authority between institutions, limited supervisory facilities, difficulties in proving on the high seas, and disparities between sanctions and economic benefits for perpetrators, resulting in less than optimal deterrence. Strengthening of technology-based supervisory systems, institutional synergy, and a proportional legal approach between the ultimum remedium function for small-scale fishermen and firm action against large business actors and foreign vessels are needed
papers.summary_cn: 本研究依据印尼2009年第45号渔业法，分析渔业经营许可（SIUP）、捕捞许可（SIPI）及渔船许可（SIKPI）违规行为的法律规制与执法实践，并以法院判决（第72/Pid.Sus-Prk/2024/PN.Rkb号）为案例。采用规范性法律研究方法，结合立法、案例与概念路径，发现许可制度法律基础明确，但风险导向的在线许可政策调整后，大型经营者的刑事违法性质未消除。执法仍受机构权限重叠、监管设施不足、公海取证困难及制裁与收益失衡制约，威慑效果有限。建议强化技术监管、机构协同，并对小规模渔民适用ultimum remedium原则、对大型经营者和外国渔船采取严厉措施。

papers.title: Lack of Capacity: The Not‐So‐Hidden Factor Undermining Fisheries Governance
papers.authors: Bianca, Haas; Transform, Aqorau; Mitchell, Lennan
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The demand for marine resources is increasing, and an increasing number of fish stocks are fully or overexploited. To turn this downward projection around, states need to strengthen the effectiveness, equity and implementation of fisheries management measures. One important component that often determines the performance of fisheries management is the capacity of the participating parties. Despite the increased global awareness regarding the need for enhanced capacity support, many coastal developing states still lack the skills and tools to implement conservation and management measures effectively. In this paper, we highlight some of the current issues in capacity building, looking at the individual, national and regional levels. We argue that capacity is a core determinant of equity and effectiveness in fisheries governance. Furthermore, we describe the potential of complementary mechanisms to provide capacity support. Specifically, we focus on the climate change regime and the Agreement on Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction. Unless coastal developing states have the sustained scientific, legal, technical, institutional and financial capacity to participate meaningfully in regional fisheries management organisations, the adoption of conservation and management measures will not necessarily translate into effective or equitable outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究指出，海洋资源需求增长导致多数鱼类种群被充分或过度开发，而参与方能力不足是制约渔业管理成效的关键因素。作者从个体、国家和区域层面分析了能力建设现存问题，主张能力是渔业治理公平性与有效性的核心决定因素。文章探讨了气候变化机制及国家管辖范围以外生物多样性协定作为补充支持渠道的潜力，强调若沿海发展中国家缺乏持续的科技、法律、制度及财政能力，区域渔业管理措施难以转化为实际成效。

papers.title: AquaMambaTrack: Reliability-First Mamba ReID for Underwater Fish Multi-Object Tracking
papers.authors: Xiong, Xiong; Chen, Xiaoyan; Yang, Bing; Yin, Lina; Yao, Bohuai
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: High-density underwater fish multi-object tracking remains difficult because occlusion, small targets, background similarity, and noisy observations destabilize identity evidence. We study a reliability-first temporal identity memory in which a successful association does not automatically authorize an identity-memory update. AquaMambaTrack (AMT) decouples geometric/motion-state updates from admission to an online per-track FIFO: only observations that satisfy stage, geometry, appearance, and crowd-reliability checks enter the history aggregated by Mamba. With fixed official MFT25 detections and official TrackEval, AMT-L48 obtains 53.473 HOTA, 41.112 AssA, 59.543 IDF1, 85.265 MOTA, and 507 IDSW. In the write-policy ladder, unfiltered FIFO writing gives 47.973 HOTA and 33.189 AssA, whereas the complete policy gives 53.473 and 41.112; the GT-evaluable history-contamination rate decreases from 27.89% to 14.35%. Online track-conditioned history exceeds detection-linked history without fallback by 5.933 HOTA and the documented T = 1 fallback path by 4.210 HOTA. Across seeds 0, 1, and 2, L = 48 gives 52.662 ± 0.769 HOTA, and Mamba has the highest mean association metrics among the evaluated encoders in the same pipeline. The gain is not universal: at the common detection-score threshold of 0.15, SU-T has fewer raw ID switches (381) on MFT25; in the internal cross-scene case study, AMT leads HOTA, DetA, and MOTA but not AssA or IDF1, and has the most raw ID switches (82). Under precomputed detections, the cold-cache tracking pipeline runs at 30.33 ± 2.72 FPS.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究提出AquaMambaTrack（AMT），一种面向高密度水下鱼类多目标跟踪的可靠性优先方法，通过解耦几何/运动状态更新与身份记忆准入机制，仅将满足阶段、几何、外观及拥挤度检查的观测写入由Mamba聚合的在线per-track FIFO，以缓解遮挡、小目标及背景相似导致的身份不稳定。在官方MFT25检测和TrackEval评估下，AMT-L48取得53.473 HOTA、41.112 AssA、59.543 IDF1、85.265 MOTA及507 IDSW；完整写入策略较未过滤FIFO提升HOTA 5.5，历史污染率从27.89%降至14.35%，且在线轨迹条件历史优于检测关联历史。跨种子实验显示L=48时HOTA为52.662±0.769，Mamba编码器在关联指标上表现最优，但增益非普适：在检测分数阈值0.15下SU-T原始ID切换更少（381次），内部跨场景案例中AMT虽领先HOTA、DetA和MOTA，但AssA、IDF1及原始ID切换（82次）不占优；预计算检测下冷缓存跟踪管线运行速度为30.33±2.72 FPS。

papers.title: Altered yellow perch stock-recruit relationships in Saginaw Bay, Lake Huron
papers.authors: Gardner, Spencer T; Meyer, Justin Robert; Briggs, Andrew; Fielder, David G.; Goedde, Greenley Rylyn; Collingsworth, Paris D.; Höök, Tomas O.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: In Saginaw Bay, a large productive embayment of Lake Huron, yellow perch (Perca flavescens) experienced a multi-decadal decline in adult abundance despite increasing fall age-0 abundance, suggesting a shift in recruitment dynamics. To assess the relative influence of ecosystem changes in altering yellow perch stock-recruit relationships, we compared candidate models, assuming either stationary or nonstationary dynamics, to evaluate potential shifts in the age at which year-class strength is set and the importance of environmental and biotic factors in explaining yellow perch age-0 and age-1 relative abundance (1970-2022). Results indicate that the age when year-class strength is established may have shifted from age-0 to age-1 in the early-2000s. Models incorporating nonstationarity best explained annual variation in yellow perch age-0 (~83%) and age-1 (~65%) relative abundance. High age-0 production was attributed to reduced competition and predation following the 2003-2004 collapse of alewife (Alosa pseudoharengus). However, increasing walleye (Sander vitreus) abundance, coincident with alewife declines, may have increased predation on age-1 yellow perch, leading to declines in age-1 relative abundance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对休伦湖Saginaw湾黄鲈（Perca flavescens）成体丰度长期下降而秋季0龄幼鱼增加的现象，通过比较平稳与非平稳动态候选模型，评估生态系统变化对stock-recruit关系的影响（1970-2022年）。结果显示，2000年代初年类强度建立年龄可能从0龄转向1龄，非平稳模型分别解释了0龄和1龄相对丰度年际变异的约83%和65%。高0龄产量归因于2003-2004年alewife（Alosa pseudoharengus）崩溃后竞争与捕食压力降低，但walleye（Sander vitreus）丰度增加可能加剧对1龄黄鲈的捕食，导致其相对丰度下降。

papers.title: One Lake, Two Basins – Does Productivity Define Fish and Food Web Mercury Dynamics in Human-impacted Lake Vesijärvi, Southern Finland?
papers.authors: Piro, A. J.; Weckström, J.; Malinen, T.; Kulo, K.; Kahilainen, K. K.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦芬兰南部受人类影响的Vesijärvi湖，探讨其两个流域的生产力差异是否决定鱼类及食物网中汞（Hg）动态。通过对比分析，旨在揭示湖泊富营养化与汞生物累积的耦合机制，为渔业管理和污染防控提供科学依据。

papers.title: Stock Assessment and Management Recommendations for the Sustainable Fishery of Tropical Shad (Terubok), Tenualosa toli, in Sarawak Waters, Malaysia
papers.authors: Azrie, Nur; Amin, S. M. Nurul; Arshad, Aziz; Kamarudin, Mohd Salleh; Yusoff, Fatimah M.; Majeed, Samroz
papers.abstract: The population of Tenualosa toli is primarily distributed in the coastal and estuarine waters of Sarawak, Malaysia, where landings have declined steadily from 1031 tons in 2003 to 586 tons in 2013. To assess stock status and support sustainable management, samples were collected between May 2016 and October 2017. Length-based stock assessment methods, including the TropFishR package and the Length-Based Bayesian Biomass (LBB) model, were used to estimate growth, mortality, exploitation, and biomass indicators. Growth analysis yielded an asymptotic length (L∞) of 57.81 cm, a growth coefficient (K) of 0.34 yr−1, a growth performance index (φ′) of 3.09, and a theoretical age at zero length (t0) of −0.40. Mortality estimates indicated total mortality (Z) of 1.82 yr−1, with natural mortality (M) of 0.49 yr−1 and fishing mortality (F) of 1.33 yr−1. The exploitation rate (E) was estimated at 0.73, substantially higher than the optimal level (E = 0.50), indicating excessive fishing pressure. The length at first capture (Lc50 = 19.16 cm) was considerably lower than the length at first maturity (Lm50 = 31.91 cm), suggesting that most individuals are harvested before reaching maturity. The optimal length (Lopt) was estimated at 35.0 cm (Lopt/L∞ = 0.67), while the observed mean length was much smaller (Lmean/Lopt = 0.73), indicating growth overfishing. Biomass indicators were critically low, with B/B0 = 0.017 and B/BMSY = 0.046, confirming that the stock is severely depleted and far below sustainable levels, suggesting recruitment overfishing. Overall, the results indicate that the fishery is experiencing both growth and recruitment overfishing due to intense harvesting of immature individuals and high fishing pressure. Therefore, management measures such as increasing mesh size, reducing fishing mortality to sustainable levels (F = M), and protecting spawning grounds and peak spawning seasons are urgently required. If these measures are effectively implemented, the T. toli stock could recover and reach sustainable production levels in the waters of Sarawak, Malaysia.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2016-2017年样本，采用TropFishR和Length-Based Bayesian Biomass (LBB)模型对马来西亚砂拉越水域热带鲥鱼（Terubok, Tenualosa toli）进行stock assessment。结果显示该种群遭受过度捕捞：开发率E=0.73远超最优水平0.50，首次捕获体长（19.16 cm）远低于性成熟体长（31.91 cm），且生物量指标极低（B/B0=0.017, B/BMSY=0.046），表明同时存在生长型和补充型过度捕捞。建议通过增大网目尺寸、将捕捞死亡率降至可持续水平（F=M）及保护产卵场和繁殖高峰期等措施，以促进种群恢复。

papers.title: Diet and isotopic ecology of subantarctic fur seal at the subtropical Amsterdam Island
papers.authors: Cherel, Yves; Trouvé, Colette; Beauplet, Gwénaël; Tremblay, Yann; Richard, Pierre; Guinet, Christophe
papers.summary_cn: 研究了亚南极毛皮海狮在亚热带阿姆斯特丹岛的食性与同位素生态。通过分析稳定同位素，揭示其摄食习性与营养生态位。结果表明该种群依赖当地海域的特定饵料资源，为理解其栖息地利用与保护提供基础数据。

papers.title: Enhancement of IoT Security in VLSI by Boolean Two Fish Crypto Algorithm
papers.authors: Evanchalin, S. Mary; Ravi, R.
