Largely under the auspices of the National Marine Fisheries Service, the United States is a global leader in the sustainable fisheries industry. For many reasons described herein, we assert that major revisions to how we manage federal marine fisheries are needed, and we posit that now is the time to make these changes. We acknowledge that there are challenges to our proposed revisions to the science-to-management process, including the following: Ecosystem-based fisheries management is currently permitted but not required under law; questions remain about appropriate management of weak-stock fisheries under single-species or ecosystem management; and institutional inertia and the desire to maintain status quo, among others. We also posit that changing to and starting with an ecosystem-oriented focus can improve ecosystem resilience, reduce management complexity, and ultimately improve economic performance. We present an eight-step proposal to engender meaningful action for how to better meet the mission of managing the nation’s living marine resources.
papers.summary_cn: 本文探讨美国海洋捕捞渔业科学与管理模式的改革必要性，主张推进基于生态系统的渔业管理（EBFM）。作者指出当前单鱼种管理存在局限，并提出八步改革方案，旨在增强生态系统韧性、降低管理复杂性并提升经济效益。研究强调法律调整、弱种群管理及制度惯性等挑战，呼吁立即行动以优化国家海洋生物资源管理。

papers.title: Climate–stressed coastal: Reconfiguring marine fisheries port management
papers.authors: Airawati, M.N.; Fauzi, Ibnu; Kustiyanto, Eko; Qonita, Zulfa; Cahyani Putri, Nofika; Prabawardani, Destianingrum Ratna; Prijambodo, Tjahjono; Wibawa, Bakti; Hidayat, Arif; Budi Prasetyo, Ridwan
papers.journal: Malaysian Journal of Society and Space
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦气候压力下沿海渔业港口管理重构问题，旨在探讨气候变化对港口运营与渔业资源利用的冲击。通过分析港口管理体系的适应性调整，提出在气候胁迫背景下优化港口功能配置与渔业管理策略的路径。研究强调港口作为渔业产业链关键节点，需在气候适应框架下重新配置管理机制，以保障渔业可持续性。

papers.title: Assessment of Genotoxic, Oxidative Stress and Histopathological Effects of Azo Dye Acid Red 119 on Blood and Gill of Freshwater Fish Channa punctata
papers.authors: Kaur, Harpal; Saini, Divya; Khanna, Aditi; Chadha, Pooja
papers.journal: Journal of Biochemical and Molecular Toxicology
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The unregulated release of azo dyes from textile industry effluents into freshwater systems constitutes a serious environmental and toxicological concern. The current investigation was undertaken to elucidate the acute toxicological impact of Acid Red 119 (AR 119) in the blood and gill of freshwater fish Channa punctata , using a multi‐tiered biomarker approach encompassing genotoxic, biochemical, and histopathological endpoints. Experimental exposures involved two sub‐lethal concentrations of AR 119−15.90 and 31.81 mg/L‐administered over a 96 h period. The results revealed a dose‐dependent and statistically significant increase in frequencies of micronucleated cells, nuclear and cellular abnormalities, and DNA damage, evidenced by elevated values of comet assay parameters such as tail length and %tail intensity, tail moment, and olive tail moment. Biochemical analysis demonstrated a significant elevation in MDA content, indicating increased lipid peroxidation, along with alterations in SOD and GST activities in blood and gill tissues. The effects were more pronounced at the higher concentration (31.81 mg/L), especially after 96 h of exposure. Histopathological analysis further showed gill tissue damage, including aneurism, epithelial lifting, vacuolization, and fusion of secondary lamellae. Taken together, these findings demonstrated that AR 119 exerts marked genotoxic and oxidative stress in C. punctata , underscoring the urgent need for stricter effluent regulation and sustainable treatment strategies in textile industries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了偶氮染料酸性红119（AR 119）对淡水鱼斑鳢（Channa punctata）血液和鳃的急性毒性效应，采用遗传毒性、生化及组织病理学多指标方法。实验设置15.90和31.81 mg/L两个亚致死浓度，暴露96小时，结果显示剂量依赖性显著增加微核细胞频率、核及细胞异常、DNA损伤（彗星参数如尾长、尾强度、尾矩等升高），并伴随MDA含量上升及SOD、GST活性改变，高浓度组效应更明显。组织病理学观察显示鳃组织损伤，包括动脉瘤、上皮 lifting、空泡化和次级鳃片融合。结论表明AR 119对斑鳢具有显著遗传毒性和氧化应激效应，强调纺织废水排放监管和可持续处理的紧迫性。

papers.title: Microbiota Stability and Antibiotic Resistance in Wild Fish Over-Exposed to Filtered Wastewater treatment plant Effluents: an in situ caging experiment
papers.authors: Janvier, Benjamin; Leloup, Julie; Berthe, Thierry; Grall, Nathalie; Delannoy, Sabine; Alliot, Fabrice; Guigon, Elodie; Marchand, Etienne; petit, fabienne; Goutte, Aurelie
papers.abstract: Abstract Antimicrobial resistance (AMR), driven by use and misuse of antibiotics, has become a major global health threat. In high-income countries, urban rivers receiving treated effluents from wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) can be considered “hot-spot environments” that promote the dissemination of Antibiotic resistant bacteria (ARB) between humans and wildlife. Here, we assessed the role of wild fish in the dissemination of AMR in a highly urbanized river (Orge River, France), based on the One Health approach and an interdisciplinary research strategy. An in-situ caging experiment was performed to assess impact of over-exposure to filtered WWTP effluent, on AMR within microbiota of wild fish. After 7 and 20 days, ARGs content, bacterial diversity, and phenotypic profiles of antibiotic resistance of bacteria (ARB) of clinical interest, were analyzed in both gut and skin microbiota. This study shows that while multidrug-resistant Aeromonas and Pseudomonas could be isolated from wild fish, an overexposure to filtered WWTP effluent did not lead to an increase of ARB or ARG in fish microbiota, but altered the structure of skin microbiota, reducing Alphaproteobacteria and increasing clinically relevant Gammaproteobacteria .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过原位caging实验，探讨了野生鱼类过度暴露于过滤后的污水处理厂（WWTP）出水对其微生物组中抗生素耐药性（AMR）的影响。基于One Health方法，在法国Orge河开展实验，分析了7天和20天后肠道及皮肤微生物组中的抗生素耐药基因（ARGs）、细菌多样性和临床相关耐药菌（ARB）表型。结果显示，尽管从野生鱼中分离出多重耐药的Aeromonas和Pseudomonas，但过度暴露未增加ARGs或ARB丰度，却显著改变了皮肤微生物组结构，降低了Alphaproteobacteria并增加了临床相关的Gammaproteobacteria。研究提示WWTP出水可能通过微生物组重塑而非直接富集耐药性，影响野生鱼类健康。

papers.title: Mycotoxins in aquaculture: a comprehensive review of global occurrence, multi-toxicological mechanisms, and sustainable mitigation strategies
papers.authors: Wang, Xin; Sun, Xiaoming; Su, Jiazi; Li, Yufei; Yang, Zhiyong; Li, Xunan; Zhang, Jingwei; Han, Wenzhao; Zhang, Dongming; Lei, Xinyu
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了水产养殖中真菌毒素的全球发生规律，涵盖主要毒素类型、污染水平及地理分布特征。文章深入解析了真菌毒素的多重毒理机制，包括对鱼类生长、免疫及生殖系统的损伤途径。最后，综述提出了可持续的缓解策略，如生物降解、饲料管理及物理化学脱毒技术，为保障水产品安全提供科学依据。

papers.title: Design and Experimental Evaluation of a Bottom-Drain and Modified-Screw Lifting System for Efficient Adult Fish Harvesting and Digital Sorting in Industrialized Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Liu, Andong; Zhang, Chenglin; Guan, Chongwu; Zhang, Yulei
papers.abstract: To address the challenges of low efficiency, high labour intensity, severe fish damage, and insufficient intelligence in adult fish harvesting within industrialised aquaculture systems, this study developed an integrated harvesting and sorting system incorporating bottom-drain fish collection, automatic herding, a modified screw-lifting mechanism, and digital grading. The system employs a bottom-discharge port on the culture tank—controlled by an electric ball valve—to replace manual net-herding, enabling simultaneous fish-and-water drainage. An automatic herding cart with a retractable net (equipped with surface floats and bottom weights) achieves bottom-hugging herding to prevent fish escape. A multi-column convolutional neural network (MCNN) fish-density recognition model was deployed above the collection tank to adaptively adjust the push-board position, thereby avoiding compression injury. The screw blade head was modified by removing the inlet-edge portions to eliminate the fish-cutting zone, reducing the mean damage rate from 1.8% to 1.32% (N = 12; 66.7% of trials recorded zero damage). Twelve repeated full-scale harvesting trials were conducted using largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides; body length 20–30 cm, body mass 300–500 g) in a 2.5 m diameter PP circular tank. Results showed a mean collection efficiency of 95.94 ± 3.33% (p < 0.001), a mean damage rate of 1.32 ± 1.96%, and a mean sorting accuracy of 96.83 ± 2.50% (p = 0.014). The MCNN model attained a recognition accuracy of 78–85%. The proposed system realises automated, intelligent, and low-damage fish harvesting, providing technical support for fully automated production-line aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对工业化水产养殖中成鱼捕捞效率低、劳动强度大、鱼体损伤严重及智能化不足等问题，设计并评估了一套集成底部排水集鱼、自动驱赶、改良螺旋提升及数字分级的捕捞分选系统。系统采用电动球阀控制培养池底部排水口替代人工网捕，实现鱼水同步排放；自动驱赶车配备可伸缩网具（含水面浮子和底部配重）实现贴底驱赶防逃逸；基于多列卷积神经网络（MCNN）的鱼密度识别模型自适应调节推板位置以减少挤压损伤。通过12次全尺寸重复试验（大口黑鲈，体长20–30 cm，体重300–500 g，2.5 m直径PP圆池），结果显示平均集鱼效率为95.94 ± 3.33%（p < 0.001），平均损伤率为1.32 ± 1.96%（改良螺旋叶片去除入口边缘后损伤率从1.8%降至1.32%，66.7%试验零损伤），平均分选精度为96.83 ± 2.50%（p = 0.014），MCNN识别准确率为78–85%。该系统实现了自动化、智能化、低损伤的成鱼捕捞，为全自动化生产线水产养殖提供了技术支撑。

papers.title: Development of an Inexact Regional Aquaculture System Planning Model to Provide Corresponding Optimal Sustainable Resource Allocation Schemes
papers.authors: Liu, Huabai; Li, Jiawei; Cao, Chen; Li, Xiao; Liu, Jing
papers.abstract: The Guidelines for Sustainable Aquaculture (GSAs) emphasize that formulating proper regional development plans is essential for achieving sustainable growth in aquaculture. Conventional research has limitations in allocating resources from a regional scale, subject to various constraints relating to the social, economic, environmental, and other domains. To fill this research gap, this study proposes an inexact regional aquaculture system planning model (IRAM) to optimally allocate resources including energy, water, area, media, and labor among various aquaculture species across multiple aquafarms under uncertainty. The model is applied to Fujian Province, China, over a 15-year planning horizon (2026–2040, three 5-year periods). As model-based scenario insights derived under specific assumptions, the main findings are as follows: (i) the system cost would increase by [18.75, 20.00]%, while the product output would greatly rise by [41.57, 47.54]% from period 1 to period 3; (ii) renewable energy (wind and solar) would supply [60.32, 81.05]% of the total electricity by period 3; (iii) shallow-sea culture ([48.6, 50.2]%) and pond culture ([17.6, 18.8]%) would receive the highest media allocation via internet platforms, supporting community communication; and (iv) pollutant and carbon emissions would decline due to the adoption of low-carbon feed and renewable energy penetration. The findings are scenario-dependent, and their practical applicability relies on the sensitivity analysis and model code/data availability discussed in the main text. One limitation lies in its inadequate ability to handle stochastic and fuzzy information commonly encountered in real-world planning problems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出了一种非精确区域水产养殖系统规划模型（IRAM），用于在不确定性条件下优化分配能源、水、面积、培养基和劳动力等资源，以支持多养殖场、多物种的可持续水产养殖发展。以中国福建省为案例，覆盖2026–2040年三个5年规划期，模型结果显示：系统成本增加[18.75, 20.00]%，但产量大幅提升[41.57, 47.54]%；至第三期，可再生能源（风能和太阳能）供应总电力的[60.32, 81.05]%；浅海养殖和池塘养殖分别获得最高的培养基分配份额；同时，低碳饲料和可再生能源渗透显著降低污染物和碳排放。模型发现依赖于情景假设，且在处理随机和模糊信息方面存在局限。

papers.title: Ginseng and its immuno-boosting properties: effects on fish immunity, mechanisms of action, and challenges in aquaculture
papers.authors: Yousefi, Morteza; Adilbekov, Zhanat; Balji, Yuriy; Аubakirova, Gulzhan; Koshekbay, Zhassulan; Ghafarifarsani, Hamed; Ahmadifar, Ehsan
papers.abstract: Modern aquaculture is challenged by disease outbreaks caused by environmental stress and immune suppression in fish. The indiscriminate use of antibiotics has accelerated antimicrobial resistance and has demanded urgent need of natural and sustainable alternatives to enhance fish health. The present review is devoted to ginseng, a plant of the genus Panax , whose rich content of ginsenosides has well-documented antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. This paper summarizes the mechanisms of ginseng in modulating the immune system of fish, highlighting the regulation of key signaling pathways, including NF-κB, JAK/STAT, MAPK, and PI3K/Akt, which results in balanced cytokine production, augmented antioxidant activity, and improved immune cell function. Evidence from trials in species such as tilapia, trout, and carp demonstrates that dietary supplementation with ginseng can increase resistance to bacterial pathogens and reduce dependency on antibiotics. However, challenges remain regarding dosage optimization, extract standardization, and evaluation of long-term effects. Overall, ginseng represents a promising natural immunostimulant for sustainable aquaculture, but further research is needed to establish standardized and effective application protocols.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了人参（Panax属）作为天然免疫刺激剂在水产养殖中的应用潜力，旨在应对环境应激和免疫抑制引发的疾病暴发及抗生素耐药性问题。研究总结了人参皂苷通过调控NF-κB、JAK/STAT、MAPK和PI3K/Akt等关键信号通路，调节鱼类免疫系统，增强抗氧化活性和免疫细胞功能。来自罗非鱼、鳟鱼和鲤鱼等物种的试验证据表明，饲料中添加人参可提高对细菌病原体的抵抗力并减少抗生素依赖。然而，剂量优化、提取物标准化及长期效应评估仍是挑战，未来需建立标准化应用方案以推动可持续水产养殖发展。

papers.title: Fish diversity and conservation status across habitat guilds in the river Rupnarayan, West Bengal, India
papers.authors: Kar, Mridul Kanti; Khan, Mohd Shahnawaz; Danda, Anamitra Anurag; Joshi, Kripal Datt
papers.abstract: The Rupnarayan River, a major tributary of the Hugli in West Bengal, extends approximately 75 km and exhibits distinct hydrological and morphological characteristics, including tidal influence, dynamic salinity gradients, and a meandering channel. The river transitions from a freshwater system upstream to a brackish estuarine environment downstream, supporting diverse floodplain habitats, fisheries, nutrient cycling, and sediment transport. A comprehensive assessment of ichthyofaunal diversity recorded 55 fish species belonging to 31 families, based on field surveys, fishers’ interviews, and secondary literature. Cyprinidae and Bagridae were the most species-rich families. The highest Shannon diversity index (H′ = 3.28) was recorded at the Denan canal confluence, indicating spatial variation in fish community composition. The assemblage included freshwater, brackish, and euryhaline species, reflecting the river’s transitional salinity regime and ecological connectivity. The river also provides important habitat for migratory fishes, including the anadromous Hilsa Shad Tenualosa ilisha and Toli Shad Tenualosa toli, and the catadromous Indian Mottled Eel Anguilla bengalensis. Several native species, such as catfishes and snakeheads, contribute to ecosystem regulation by preying on insect larvae, including mosquitoes, thereby offering natural pest control services. Fish species showed varied spatial distributions, with some restricted to specific microhabitats and others widely distributed throughout the river. Assessment against IUCN Red List categories indicated that while most recorded species were classified as Least Concern (LC), several were categorised as Near Threatened (NT), Vulnerable (VU), Data Deficient (DD), or Not Evaluated (NE). The co-occurrence of native, migratory, and exotic species highlights the complex conservation challenges associated with environmental change, fishing pressure, and species introductions. These findings provide an important baseline for developing evidence-based conservation and management strategies to maintain fish diversity, ecological integrity, and the livelihoods of communities dependent on the Rupnarayan River.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度西孟加拉邦Rupnarayan河（胡格利河主要支流）的鱼类多样性与保护状况，该河具有潮汐影响、盐度梯度和蜿蜒河道等独特水文特征。通过野外调查、渔民访谈和文献资料，共记录55种鱼类（隶属31科），其中鲤科和鲿科物种最丰富，Denan运河汇合处Shannon多样性指数最高（H′=3.28）。鱼类群落包含淡水、咸淡水及广盐性物种，并支持洄游鱼类如Hilsa Shad（Tenualosa ilisha）和印度花鳗（Anguilla bengalensis）的栖息。IUCN红色名录评估显示多数物种为无危（LC），但部分为近危（NT）、易危（VU）、数据缺乏（DD）或未评估（NE），原生种、洄游种和外来种的共存凸显了环境变化、捕捞压力和物种引入带来的复杂保护挑战，为制定基于证据的保护管理策略提供了基线数据。

papers.title: Condition the water before adding the fish: a hypothesis on probiotic selection without prior gut assessment
papers.authors: Chun, Puiman; Wu, Xiaoli; Liang, Shan; Jin, Feng
papers.abstract: Introduction Current clinical practice often assumes that gut microbiome assessment before selecting probiotic species, assuming a ‘test-then-match’ strategy yields better outcomes. However, routine testing has limited predictive value for probiotic efficacy, and many commercial probiotics fail to achieve sustained clinical improvement. Methods In this Hypothesis and Theory article, we propose a novel, testable hypothesis: prioritize remodelling the gut environment using metabolically potent probiotics, (i.e., strains with high capacity to produce beneficial metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids, bioactive peptides, and organic acids) without prior microbiome assessment—a ‘condition-then-attract’ strategy. Our hypothesis is motivated by preclinical studies demonstrating the metabolic potency of specific strains of Lactobacillus helveticus and Lactobacillus fermentum (e.g., NS8 and NS9 originally isolated from Mongolian fermented koumiss). Results We derive several directly testable predictions from this framework, including that a randomized controlled trial comparing ‘test-then-match’ versus ‘condition-then-attract’ strategies would show that prior gut assessment does not improve outcomes, and that metabolically potent probiotics will outperform less active strains regardless of species identity. Discussion We contend that refocusing from species-level matching to strain-level metabolic potency may offer a more effective and simpler alternative. Future research should prioritize metabolic potency over colony-forming unit counts and reconsider the necessity of routine pre-intervention gut assessment. Our framework does not rely on a single metabolite but embraces diverse mechanisms—proteolysis, carbohydrate fermentation, pH modulation—that collectively restore gut homeostasis.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究提出一种新的益生菌选择假说：无需事先进行肠道菌群评估，优先选用代谢能力强的菌株（如产短链脂肪酸、生物活性肽和有机酸）来重塑肠道环境，即“先调理后吸引”策略。基于瑞士乳杆菌和发酵乳杆菌（如NS8、NS9）的临床前研究，作者推导出可检验的预测，认为代谢效力优于物种匹配，随机对照试验将显示事先评估不改善结果。该框架强调菌株级代谢效力而非菌落形成单位计数，为肠道稳态恢复提供更简单有效的替代方案。非渔业相关。

papers.title: How upstream wakes help fish with energy-efficient propulsion
papers.authors: Bandari, Anashe
papers.abstract: Because of their flexible bodies, fish can use nearby vortices to accelerate forward, enabling passive propulsion.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨鱼类如何利用上游尾流中的涡旋实现节能推进。通过分析柔性鱼体与周围涡流的相互作用，发现鱼类可借助邻近涡旋获得前进动力，从而实现被动推进。该发现为理解鱼类游动节能机制及仿生水下航行器设计提供了新见解。

papers.title: Genetic Diversity and Population Structure of an Endemic Fish, Nemacheilus subfusca, in the Lower Yarlung Zangbo River Basin
papers.authors: Su, Qi; Xiong, Mantang; Yang, Yang; Chen, Feng; Jiang, Sijin; Liu, Jianfang; Zhang, Zhiming
papers.abstract: Nemacheilus subfusca is an endemic fish species in the lower Yarlung Zangbo River. Its habitats are potentially threatened by geological disturbances and anthropogenic activities, but information on population status remains limited. However, existing research has been largely confined to basic biology, with limited information on its population genetic structure and connectivity. Consequently, targeted investigations are urgently needed to provide a scientific basis for the conservation of this species. In this study, genetic diversity and population structure were analyzed in 50 individuals from two geographic populations (Motuo (MT) and Chayu (CY)) in the lower Yarlung Zangbo River, using mitochondrial cytb and D-loop markers. The populations exhibited high haplotype diversity but relatively low nucleotide diversity (cytb: Hd = 0.870, Pi = 0.00281; D-loop: Hd = 0.931, Pi = 0.01655). Notably, the MT population exhibited lower diversity levels compared to the CY population (cytb: Hd = 0.757, Pi = 0.00205; D-loop: Hd = 0.633, Pi = 0.00153). Substantial genetic differentiation was observed between the two populations (cytb: FST = 0.322; D-loop: FST = 0.733); The observed mitochondrial divergence did not provide clear evidence of species-level differentiation (cytb = 0.00331; D-loop = 0.02492). The ML phylogenetic tree and haplotype network revealed geographically associated clustering of the two populations, indicating geographic structuring of mitochondrial haplotypes. Furthermore, demographic analyses were consistent with a possible historical population expansion. In conclusion, The mitochondrial data revealed high haplotype diversity but relatively low nucleotide diversity, together with substantial genetic differentiation between the two sampled populations, forming geographically associated clusters. This study elucidates the genetic background of this species’ germplasm resources, providing baseline genetic information for future conservation and management of this species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用线粒体cytb和D-loop标记分析了雅鲁藏布江下游墨脱（MT）和察隅（CY）两个地理群体共50尾 endemic fish Nemacheilus subfusca 的遗传多样性与种群结构。结果显示两群体均具有高单倍型多样性但较低核苷酸多样性，且MT群体多样性水平低于CY群体，群体间存在显著遗传分化（cytb: FST = 0.322; D-loop: FST = 0.733），但线粒体分歧未达种级水平。系统发育树和单倍型网络显示地理相关聚类，并支持历史种群扩张事件。研究为该物种种质资源遗传背景提供了基础数据，对其保护与管理具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: First detailed insights into harbour porpoise behaviour during a bycatch event
papers.authors: Macaulay, Jamie; Kingston, Allen; Coram, Alexander; Hicks, James; Oswald, Michael; Swift, René J.; Northridge, Simon
papers.abstract: Abstract Bycatches in static nets are the greatest cause of anthropogenic mortality in small cetaceans globally; however, the mechanism underlying how animals with highly sophisticated biosonars become entangled in nets is still poorly understood and represents a key information gap. During the deployment of a multi-hydrophone passive acoustic monitoring system, we tracked the three-dimensional movements and acoustic behaviour of harbour porpoises (Phocoena phocoena) during a rarely observed bycatch event. These data provide, to our knowledge, the first comprehensive insights into the behaviour of a harbour porpoise (or any small-toothed whale) prior to and during a bycatch event in static nets. It also included behavioural information related to a second animal that was in close proximity but did not interact with the net. The results indicated that the porpoises were foraging around the net prior to the bycatch event, that the bycaught animal lifted the net by approximately 7 m while entangled and that the two animals were potentially a social unit, with the surviving porpoise exhibiting unusual communication behaviour for several hours after the bycatch occured. Understanding behaviours prior to and during a bycatch event could significantly improve bycatch mitigation strategies in static net fisheries, and this paper demonstrates a new method for how this can be achieved.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次通过多水听器被动声学监测系统，记录并追踪了港海豚（Phocoena phocoena）在静态网兼捕事件前后的三维运动与声学行为。结果显示，兼捕前海豚正在网具周围觅食，被兼捕个体缠网时将网具抬升约7米，且两只海豚可能构成社会单元，幸存个体在事件后数小时表现出异常通讯行为。该发现为理解小型齿鲸兼捕机制提供了关键数据，并展示了通过声学追踪改进静态网渔业兼捕缓解策略的新方法。

papers.title: Fishermen-led documentation of bycatch of sea snakes (Serpentes: Elapidae: Hydrophiinae) on the Malabar coast of southwestern India
papers.authors: R. Sree Vishnu; S.R. Ganesh
papers.abstract: Sea snakes are prominent among marine fishery bycatch and few studies have examined the gravity of this problem in Indian coastline fisheries. We examine sea snake bycatch on the Malabar Coast in southwestern India during a study period from September 2024 to January 2025 that was conducted in eight harbours in southern Karnataka and northern Kerala over a 15-week period. Sea snake bycatch photos were obtained directly from fishermen aboard vessels, and among 22 photos we identified three sea snake species: Short Sea Snake Hydrophis curtus (13 dead, 4 live), Annulated Sea Snake H. cyanocinctus (4 dead), and Hook-nosed Sea Snake H. schistosus (1 dead). We also interacted with fishermen and shared e-posters on sea snake bycatch issues during awareness outreach efforts in the study area.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过渔民合作记录，调查了印度西南部马拉巴尔海岸海蛇兼捕问题。2024年9月至2025年1月期间，在卡纳塔克邦南部和喀拉拉邦北部的8个港口开展15周调查，共收集22张兼捕照片，鉴定出3种海蛇：短海蛇（Hydrophis curtus，13死4活）、环纹海蛇（H. cyanocinctus，4死）和钩鼻海蛇（H. schistosus，1死）。此外，研究还通过渔民互动和电子海报宣传提高了对海蛇兼捕问题的认知。

papers.title: Abundance and behaviour of detritivorous fish as indicators of reef degradation in the Pemba Channel, Tanzania
papers.authors: Lomax, Aliyah; Osuka-Edeye, Kennedy
papers.abstract: Coral reef degradation is changing benthic habitats globally, with increasing transitions from structurally complex coral frameworks to rubble- and sediment dominated substrates. This study examined how habitat structure influences the abundance and behaviour of two surgeonfish, Naso brevirostris and Naso hexacanthus , across a coral–rubble gradient around Pemba Island, Tanzania, using Baited Remote Underwater Video systems (BRUVs). Forty deployments were analysed to quantify relative abundance (MaxN), behavioural prevalence and intensity, and temporal behavioural variation during each BRUV deployment. Depth and benthic composition were also analysed as environmental predictors. Abundance showed significant species-specific responses to habitat condition. N. brevirostris was associated with structurally complex coral habitats, whereas N. hexacanthus was more abundant in degraded rubble-dominated areas. In contrast, behaviour remained consistent, with no significant differences in behavioural prevalence or intensity between species or habitat types. Temporal analyses revealed short-term variation in feeding and social behaviours linked to changes in resource availability and aggregation dynamics, rather than habitat condition. Depth influenced the benthic composition but was not a significant predictor of fish abundance or behavioural responses. The findings suggest that habitat degradation changes the distribution of detritivorous fishes, while their behaviour remains stable across habitat conditions. The contrasting abundance patterns challenge broader generalisations of detritivore responses to reef degradation. Stable behaviour despite changes in species distribution suggests that key detrital processing functions may persist despite ongoing habitat simplification
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过Baited Remote Underwater Video systems (BRUVs)在坦桑尼亚Pemba岛珊瑚- rubble梯度上调查了两种食碎屑刺尾鱼（Naso brevirostris和Naso hexacanthus）的丰度与行为对珊瑚礁退化的响应。基于40次部署的MaxN、行为发生率和强度分析，发现丰度呈物种特异性响应：N. brevirostris偏好结构复杂的珊瑚生境，而N. hexacanthus在退化rubble区域更丰富；行为则在不同生境间保持稳定，短期摄食和社会行为变化主要受资源可得性和聚集动态驱动，而非生境条件。结果表明栖息地退化改变食碎屑鱼类分布，但行为稳定性可能维持碎屑处理功能，挑战了食碎屑鱼类对礁退化响应的普遍性假设。

papers.title: A novel uncertainty-aware 3D tracking solver based on physics-informed neural networks
papers.authors: Chen, Wenqian; Tan, Xi; Fu, Tao; Martinez, Jayson; Peng, Guanze; Deng, Zhiqun Daniel
papers.abstract: Accurate 3D fish localization supports understanding of movement, behavior, and habitat use. Traditional solvers such as Approximate Maximum Likelihood (AML) are vulnerable to multipath, time of arrival (TOA) measurement errors, and synchronization errors, while Yet Another Positioning Solver (YAPS) can degrade with sparse detections. We introduce a physics-informed neural network (PINN) solver that models trajectories as continuous, physics-constrained functions, minimizes the negative log-likelihood of TOA noise, and quantifies uncertainty via ensemble training. We validated the approach using synthetic experiments and field deployments in the Salish Sea and a dam tailrace. Under synthetic scenarios with abrupt turns, accelerations, and gaps, the solver achieved sub-meter root mean square (RMS) errors of 0.30–0.80 m and >83% efficiency. In the Salish Sea, RMS error was 1.17–2.24 m with 23–76% efficiency, reducing RMS by ~60% versus AML, and reducing RMS by >75% versus YAPS. In the tailrace, RMS error was 0.81–0.93 m with >92% efficiency, reducing RMS by ~35% versus AML and by >80% versus YAPS. The proposed PINN solver delivers accurate localization across challenging conditions, enabling fine-scale ecological monitoring.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的新型三维追踪求解器，用于鱼类精准定位，以克服传统方法（如AML和YAPS）在多路径、TOA测量误差及稀疏检测下的局限性。该方法将轨迹建模为连续物理约束函数，通过集成训练量化不确定性，并在合成实验及Salish海与大坝尾水区实地部署中验证。结果显示，在突变转向、加速和信号缺失场景下，均方根误差（RMS）为0.30–0.80米，效率超83%；实地测试中RMS较AML降低约60–75%，较YAPS降低超75–80%，实现亚米级至米级精度。该求解器在复杂环境中提供高精度定位，支持细尺度生态监测。

papers.title: Divergent growth chronologies of a deep-water snapper along a tropical continuum in northwestern Australia
papers.authors: Gonzalez, Júlio Guazzelli; Ng, Clement Z. W.; Saleh, Muhammad Faiq; Wakefield, Corey B.; Newman, Stephen J.; Ong, Joyce Jia Lin
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦于澳大利亚西北部热带连续海域中深水鲷鱼（snapper）的生长年代学差异，旨在揭示其空间变异性及潜在驱动因素。通过分析不同地理位置的鱼类生长模式，研究发现该物种的生长速率和年龄结构沿纬度梯度呈现显著分化，可能与环境条件（如水温、食物可利用性）及种群隔离有关。结果强调了在渔业管理中需考虑区域特异性生长参数，以支持精准的stock assessment和资源养护策略。
papers.keywords_matched: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries

papers.title: Comment on “Evidence of sequential hermaphroditism in alfonsinos ( Beryx spp.) from the deep northeast Atlantic” by Cruz et al. (2025)
papers.authors: de Mitcheson, Yvonne Sadovy; Rasotto, Maria B.
papers.summary_cn: 该文是对Cruz等（2025）关于东北大西洋深海金眼鲷（*Beryx* spp.）顺序性雌雄同体证据的评论。作者针对原研究的结论提出质疑，可能涉及生殖生物学证据解读或方法学问题。评论旨在澄清或修正关于该物种性别分化模式的现有认知，对深海鱼类生活史研究具有参考意义。

papers.title: Transboundary plastic pollution from North American lobster fisheries reaches Atlantic Islands
papers.authors: Pham, Christopher K.; Vargas, Dejalme; Medeiros, Valter; Pereira, João M.; Herrera, Laura; Machado, Pedro; Rodrigues, Clara; Belaoud, Thomas; Rodríguez, Yasmina
papers.summary_cn: 北美龙虾渔业产生的跨境塑料污染已扩散至大西洋岛屿。研究追踪了渔具废弃物（如绳索、陷阱）的海洋运输路径，揭示其跨越国界的环境影响。该发现强调需国际合作治理渔业塑料垃圾，以保护偏远岛屿生态系统。

papers.title: UV-protective sunscreen compounds and their differential accumulation across ocular tissues in fish eyes from Baltic Sea
papers.authors: Karsten, Ulf; Walberg, Laureen; Krumme, Uwe; Schaub, Friederike; Stachs, Oliver; Sperlich, Karsten; Lindner, Tobias; Hammerle, Fabian; Gostner, Johanna M.; Karg, Cornelia A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Many fish species achieve ultraviolet radiation (UVR) protection by accumulating mycosporine-like amino acids (MAAs) from their diet. High concentrations are often found in the eyes, but the localization of MAAs in specific fish eye tissues is unknown. In the present study we dissected the eyes of six fish species, and prepared cornea, lens, vitreous body and a mixed tissue sample consisting of retina, choroidea and sclera (RCS). Furthermore, to test if MAAs are transferred further up the food web, we investigated the occurrence of MAAs also in eyes of warm-blooded piscine predators. Most, but not all, fish eye tissue samples contained the MAAs palythine, asterina-330, usujirene and palythene, but in different quantitative patterns. The highest MAA concentrations were found in the cornea, lens and vitreous body, while the innermost RCS layer showed a much smaller content. All data indicate that most MAAs are mainly located in the cornea and/or lens and vitreous body, thereby providing an improved photoprotection of the RCS layer, and in particular of the innermost, UVR-sensitive retina. No MAAs were detected in the eyes of cormorants and piscivorous mammals, suggesting that the trophic transfer of MAAs from the primary producers via zooplankton apparently ends in the fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过解剖波罗的海六种鱼类的眼睛，分析了角膜、晶状体、玻璃体和视网膜-脉络膜-巩膜混合组织（RCS）中mycosporine-like amino acids（MAAs）的分布。发现MAAs主要积累于角膜、晶状体和玻璃体，而RCS层含量较低，表明其优先保护对UVR敏感的视网膜。同时，温血捕食者（鸬鹚和食鱼哺乳动物）眼中未检出MAAs，提示MAAs的食物链传递止于鱼类。研究揭示了MAAs在鱼类眼部组织中的差异化积累模式及其光保护功能。

papers.title: A Study on the Development of an Instructional Model Based on the ADDIE Framework for Cultivating Fisheries and Maritime Policy Capacity
papers.authors: KIM, Mi-Hwan
papers.journal: THE JOURNAL OF FISHERIES AND MARINE SCIENCES EDUCATION
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在基于ADDIE框架开发一套教学模型，以培养渔业与海事政策能力。该模型系统涵盖分析、设计、开发、实施与评估五个阶段，为渔业政策教育提供结构化指导。研究聚焦于提升相关人员在渔业管理领域的专业素养与决策能力。

papers.title: Economic Feasibility and Sensitivity Analysis of Scallop Aquaculture in Gyeongnam, Korea
papers.authors: JO, Heonju; HONG, Jae-Beum; KANG, Hanae; PARK, Hye-Jin; LIM, Donghoon
papers.journal: THE JOURNAL OF FISHERIES AND MARINE SCIENCES EDUCATION
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了韩国庆尚南道扇贝养殖的经济可行性，通过敏感性分析考察关键变量（如售价、饲料成本、死亡率）对净收益的影响。结果显示，在基准情景下养殖项目具备盈利能力，但经济回报对市场价格波动和运营成本变化高度敏感。研究为区域扇贝养殖投资决策提供了量化依据，并强调了风险管理在 aquaculture 中的重要性。

2026-W37.topic: 渔业可持续发展与生态适应研究前沿
2026-W37.keywords: 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 鱼类营养(Fish Nutrition), 种群评估(Stock Assessment), 环境DNA(eDNA), 重金属污染(Heavy Metals), 气候变化适应(Climate Adaptation), 渔业管理(Fisheries Management), 女性参与(Women Participation)
2026-W37.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录6篇渔业相关论文，研究方向涵盖水产病害防控、鱼类生理生态、养殖模式创新、饲料安全及副产物高值化利用等。整体来看，研究呈现出明显的应用导向特征：一方面聚焦水产养殖的可持续发展与食品安全问题（如疫苗研发、生物絮团养殖、霉菌毒素污染评估），另一方面关注环境变化与养殖管理对鱼类健康及产品质量的影响（如温度与密度对汞积累的作用）。值得注意的是，本周研究在方法上体现了从传统养殖技术向分子生物学、生态能量学及循环经济理念融合的多元化趋势。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无发表在Nature、Science、PNAS等顶级期刊的论文。

## 创新性研究

1. **《The Vaccine Candidates Against Major Fish Pathogens (Pseudomonas fluorescens and Aeromonas hydrophila) from the Outer Membrane Proteins of P. fluorescens in Fish》** — 该研究系统克隆并纯化了24种荧光假单胞菌外膜蛋白（OMPs），并制备了16种小鼠抗血清，探索了跨物种疫苗开发的可行性。其创新之处在于利用一种病原菌的OMPs同时应对两种主要鱼类病原菌的感染威胁，为水产养殖中广谱疫苗的研发提供了新思路，有望降低疫苗开发成本并提高防控效率。

2. **《Ecological energetics of an imperilled fish: Physiological metrics, experimental protocols and implications for population recovery》** — 针对濒危鱼类生理数据采集困难的瓶颈，该研究系统评估了多种生态能量学指标的适用性，并提出了标准化的实验方案。其创新性在于将生理学指标与种群恢复管理直接对接，为濒危鱼类的保护性养殖和野外放归提供了可操作的量化工具，填补了该领域方法学空白。

3. **《Biofloc-based aquaculture: From monoculture to integrated systems》** — 该综述突破了传统生物絮团技术（BFT）仅用于单一养殖模式的认知框架，系统梳理了其向综合养殖系统（如鱼菜共生、多营养级综合养殖）拓展的路径与潜力。其创新性在于从系统整合的视角重新审视BFT的技术价值，为水产养殖的绿色转型提供了新的理论框架和实践方向。

4. **《Global Occurrence, Co-Contamination Patterns, and Toxic Effects of Mycotoxins in Fish Feed: A Multi-Species Perspective Review》** — 该研究首次从多鱼种视角系统分析了全球鱼饲料中霉菌毒素的发生率、共污染模式及毒性效应。其创新之处在于揭示了多种霉菌毒素共存时的协同或拮抗效应，突破了以往单一毒素风险评估的局限，对饲料安全标准的制定具有重要的参考价值。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Biofloc‐based aquaculture: From monoculture to integrated systems** — 系统梳理了BFT技术向综合养殖系统拓展的前沿方向，对理解水产养殖可持续发展路径具有重要参考价值。
2. **Ecological energetics of an imperilled fish: Physiological metrics, experimental protocols and implications for population recovery** — 为濒危鱼类生理生态研究提供了标准化方法学框架，兼具理论深度与管理应用价值。
3. **The Vaccine Candidates Against Major Fish Pathogens (Pseudomonas fluorescens and Aeromonas hydrophila) from the Outer Membrane Proteins of P. fluorescens in Fish** — 探索了跨病原菌广谱疫苗的可行性，对水产疫苗研发策略具有启发意义。
4. **Global Occurrence, Co-Contamination Patterns, and Toxic Effects of Mycotoxins in Fish Feed: A Multi-Species Perspective Review** — 首次系统揭示鱼饲料霉菌毒素共污染模式，对饲料安全风险评估方法具有革新意义。
5. **Effects of temperature and density on mercury accumulation in Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar)** — 揭示了环境温度与养殖密度对鱼类重金属积累的交互影响，对养殖管理优化和食品安全保障具有直接指导意义。

2026-W36.topic: 鱼类保护与可持续养殖：多学科研究前沿与趋势
2026-W36.keywords: 繁殖生物学(Reproductive Biology), 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 鱼类生态毒理(Ecotoxicity), 濒危鱼类保护(Endangered Fish Conservation), 鱼类种群评估(Fish Stock Assessment), 分子鉴定技术(Molecular Identification), 渔业资源管理(Fisheries Management), 鱼类早期发育(Fish Early Development)
2026-W36.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共检索到7篇渔业相关论文，研究主题较为分散，主要涵盖水产贸易与保护政策、鱼类生活史特征、贝类养殖与食品安全、渔业废弃物资源化利用以及水产品抗菌保鲜等方向。整体来看，本周研究呈现出明显的应用导向特征，涉及渔业管理政策辩论、养殖产业实践优化及水产品加工增值等现实议题；同时，宏观生态学视角下的鱼类生活史研究亦有所涉及。值得注意的是，本周论文多发表于应用型期刊（如 *Fishes*、*Foods*、*Energies*），缺乏来自顶级综合性期刊的突破性成果，研究整体偏向于领域内的渐进式推进。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无发表在Nature、Science、PNAS、Nature Climate Change、Nature Ecology & Evolution、Nature Sustainability、Nature Communications、Science Advances等高水平期刊上的论文。

## 创新性研究

1. **Body size, functional form and environmental correlates of maximum longevity in marine-occurring fishes**（*Journal of Fish Biology*）— 该研究基于757个海洋鱼类物种的大样本数据，系统检验了最大寿命与体型之间的关系形态，并首次将广泛的环境梯度纳入分析框架。其创新之处在于超越了传统单一体型-寿命异速关系的简单描述，揭示了环境因子对寿命变异的独立贡献，为海洋鱼类生活史进化理论提供了新的实证基础。

2. **Valorization of Fish Waste via Anaerobic Digestion: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Agenda**（*Energies*）— 该研究采用文献计量学与系统综述相结合的方法，系统梳理了鱼类加工和养殖废弃物通过厌氧消化转化为可再生能源的研究现状。其创新点在于将分散的跨学科证据进行整合，识别了该领域的研究空白，并提出了明确的未来研究方向，对推动渔业循环经济发展具有方法论上的示范意义。

3. **An Ecotoxicological Perspective on Bivalve Safety Frameworks: Linking HAB Management and Microbiological Limits to Physiological Responses in Shellfish**（*Journal of Marine Science and Engineering*）— 该综述从生态毒理学视角批判性地审视了现行贝类安全监管框架的局限性，指出当前基于急性人体毒性阈值的标准未能充分反映贝类-有害藻华（HAB）相互作用的生物学复杂性。这一跨学科整合视角为完善贝类安全评估体系提供了新的理论切入点。

4. **Synergistic Effects Between Chitooligosaccharide–Epigallocatechin Gallate Conjugate and Nisin on Inhibition of Seafood-Associated Vibrio spp., Aeromonas spp., and Shewanella spp.**（*Foods*）— 该研究探索了壳寡糖-表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯共轭物与乳酸链球菌素（Nisin）联用对海产品相关腐败菌和条件致病菌的协同抑制作用，为开发新型天然复合抗菌保鲜剂提供了实验依据，在方法上体现了天然产物化学与食品微生物学的交叉创新。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Body size, functional form and environmental correlates of maximum longevity in marine-occurring fishes** — 大样本量、多维度分析框架为理解海洋鱼类生活史进化提供了迄今最为系统的实证证据。
2. **Valorization of Fish Waste via Anaerobic Digestion: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Agenda** — 系统综述方法严谨，对渔业废弃物资源化领域的研究空白识别精准，具有明确的应用指导价值。
3. **An Ecotoxicological Perspective on Bivalve Safety Frameworks: Linking HAB Management and Microbiological Limits to Physiological Responses in Shellfish** — 以生态毒理学视角挑战现行监管范式，对贝类安全评估体系改革具有启发性。
4. **Seasonal Growth, Reproduction, and Health of the Pacific Oysters Cultured in an Intertidal Rack System in Garorim Bay, West Coast of Korea** — 提供了太平洋牡蛎在潮间带架式养殖系统中的完整季节性生物学数据，对养殖管理实践具有直接参考价值。
5. **Synergistic Effects Between Chitooligosaccharide–Epigallocatechin Gallate Conjugate and Nisin on Inhibition of Seafood-Associated Vibrio spp., Aeromonas spp., and Shewanella spp.** — 天然来源复合抗菌策略为海产品保鲜技术升级提供了新思路，兼具学术价值与产业转化潜力。

2026-W35.topic: 渔业可持续与生态保护：多维度研究进展综述
2026-W35.keywords: 水产保鲜技术(Seafood Preservation), 兼捕缓解(Bycatch Mitigation), 遗传种群结构(Genetic Population Structure), 可持续渔业(Sustainable Fisheries), 水产养殖病害(Aquaculture Diseases), 鱼类洄游(Fish Migration), 小型渔业(Small-Scale Fisheries), 鱼类繁殖生物学(Fish Reproductive Biology)
2026-W35.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录渔业相关论文3篇，研究方向涵盖微塑料毒理学、水产养殖政策与管理、以及鱼类种群动态与环境驱动因子分析。整体研究趋势显示，渔业科学正日益关注人类活动（如塑料污染、石油泄漏）与气候变化对鱼类生理和种群动态的复合影响，同时政策与管理层面的讨论也在持续升温。研究手段上，从细胞毒理实验到耳石年代学分析，体现了从分子到生态尺度的多层次研究范式。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无。

## 创新性研究

1. **Cellular Toxicity of Short‐ and Long‐Term Exposures to Polystyrene Nanoplastics and Microplastics in Fish Skin Cell Derived From Fathead Minnow** — 该研究首次系统比较了短期与长期暴露于聚苯乙烯纳米/微塑料对鱼类皮肤细胞的毒性差异，填补了微塑料对鱼类皮肤屏障功能影响的研究空白。其创新之处在于使用鱼类皮肤细胞系作为体外模型，为微塑料风险评估提供了更贴近实际暴露途径的实验体系，对理解微塑料经皮肤吸收的潜在健康风险具有重要意义。

2. **Sex‐Specific Multidecadal Growth of Red Drum in Relation to Environmental Drivers and Oil Spill Events in the Gulf of America** — 该研究利用耳石硬组织年代学（otolith sclerochronology）方法，首次揭示了红鼓鱼生长对环境和石油泄漏事件的性别特异性响应。其创新点在于将长期（多年代）生长数据与特定灾害事件（如石油泄漏）相关联，并区分性别差异，为理解环境扰动对鱼类种群生产力的差异化影响提供了新视角，对渔业资源管理和生态修复策略制定具有直接参考价值。

3. **When Will We Do What is Needed for U.S. Aquaculture to Grow?** — 尽管无摘要，但该文发表于渔业政策领域权威期刊，针对美国水产养殖业发展瓶颈提出关键问题，具有鲜明的政策导向性和现实意义。其创新性体现在对产业发展障碍的系统性反思，可能涉及监管框架、环境许可、市场竞争等多维度分析，对全球水产养殖政策制定具有借鉴意义。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Sex‐Specific Multidecadal Growth of Red Drum in Relation to Environmental Drivers and Oil Spill Events in the Gulf of America** — 长期耳石年代学数据与灾害事件关联，揭示性别特异性生长响应，方法严谨且管理应用价值高。
2. **Cellular Toxicity of Short‐ and Long‐Term Exposures to Polystyrene Nanoplastics and Microplastics in Fish Skin Cell Derived From Fathead Minnow** — 首次利用鱼类皮肤细胞系评估微塑料毒性，填补皮肤暴露途径研究空白，方法新颖。
3. **When Will We Do What is Needed for U.S. Aquaculture to Grow?** — 聚焦水产养殖业发展核心政策议题，对产业实践具有直接指导意义。
